plot.title: √x 与 y = x 都绝对连续：√x 的导数 1/(2√x) 无界，但 f(x)−f(0)=∫₀ˣ f′ 仍成立；康托尔函数 a.e. 导数为 0 却从 0 升到 1，不满足该公式

nodes.title: 勒贝格微分定理
nodes.summary: 勒贝格微分定理断言：局部可积函数在几乎处处的点等于其小邻域上的滑动平均的极限；这样的点称为勒贝格点。
nodes.summaryEn: The Lebesgue differentiation theorem states that a locally integrable function equals, at almost every point, the limit of its averages over shrinking neighbourhoods; such points are called Lebesgue points.

plot.title: 滑动平均 (1/2r)∫ₓ₋ᵣˣ⁺ʳ t²dt = x² + r²/3：取 r = 0.3 得 x² + 0.03，r → 0 时曲线回到 x²

nodes.title: 度量空间
nodes.summary: 给集合配上满足三条公理的「距离」，就得到度量空间；收敛、开集、闭集与连续性都在这里获得统一的表述。
nodes.summaryEn: A set equipped with a distance obeying three axioms — the common language for convergence, open and closed sets, and continuity.

plot.title: p 范数的单位球：p=1（菱形）、p=2（圆）、p=∞（正方形）

nodes.title: 完备度量空间与压缩映射原理
nodes.titleEn: Complete Metric Spaces and the Contraction Mapping Principle
nodes.summary: 每个柯西列都收敛的度量空间叫完备空间；在完备空间中，压缩映射必有唯一不动点，迭代以几何速度收敛——这就是巴拿赫不动点定理。
nodes.summaryEn: A metric space in which every Cauchy sequence converges; in such a space every contraction has a unique fixed point, approached by iteration at geometric speed — the Banach fixed point theorem.

plot.title: 迭代 xₙ₊₁ = cos xₙ 收敛到不动点 x* ≈ 0.7391

nodes.title: 赋范线性空间
nodes.summary: 带范数的线性空间：范数给出向量的「长度」，并诱导平移不变、齐次的度量；有限维时任意两个范数等价。
nodes.summaryEn: A linear space equipped with a norm — a notion of length that induces a translation-invariant, homogeneous metric; in finite dimensions all norms are equivalent.

plot.title: 同一半径下的三个单位球：ℓ¹ 菱形 ⊂ ℓ² 圆 ⊂ ℓ∞ 正方形

nodes.title: 巴拿赫空间
nodes.summary: 完备的赋范线性空间：柯西列总有极限，绝对收敛级数必收敛，迭代与一致收敛论证畅通无阻——泛函分析的主舞台。
nodes.summaryEn: A complete normed linear space: Cauchy sequences always converge, absolutely convergent series do too, and iteration and uniform-convergence arguments work — the main stage of functional analysis.

nodes.title: 内积空间与希尔伯特空间
nodes.titleEn: Inner Product Spaces and Hilbert Spaces
nodes.summary: 带内积的线性空间：内积度量长度与夹角；内积范数满足平行四边形法则，完备的内积空间就是希尔伯特空间。
nodes.summaryEn: A linear space with an inner product measuring lengths and angles; the induced norm obeys the parallelogram law, and a complete such space is a Hilbert space.

plot.title: v 到子空间 W = span{(2,1)} 的正交投影：残差 v − p 与 W 垂直

nodes.title: 正交性与投影定理
nodes.summary: 希尔伯特空间中闭子空间的正交分解定理：每个向量唯一地分解为子空间内分量与正交分量，前者是最近点——最佳逼近与傅里叶展开的几何基础。
nodes.summaryEn: The orthogonal decomposition theorem in Hilbert space: every vector splits uniquely into a component in a closed subspace plus an orthogonal component, the former being the nearest point — the geometric basis of best approximation and Fourier expansion.

plot.title: 正交分解 x = y + z：y ∈ M 是离 x 最近的点，z ⊥ M

nodes.title: 正交基与傅里叶展开
nodes.summary: 标准正交系是两两正交的单位向量系；它让求坐标只需做内积，贝塞尔不等式对任何标准正交系成立，而帕塞瓦尔等式与范数收敛的傅里叶展开恰好刻画完备性（正交基）。
nodes.summaryEn: Orthonormal systems consist of mutually orthogonal unit vectors, making coordinates computable by inner products; Bessel's inequality always holds, while Parseval's identity and norm-convergent expansion characterize completeness (an orthonormal basis).

plot.title: 正交函数系 sin x, sin 2x, sin 3x, sin 4x（在 [0, 2π] 上两两正交）

nodes.title: 有界线性算子与算子范数
nodes.titleEn: Bounded Linear Operators and the Operator Norm
nodes.summary: 有界线性算子就是连续线性算子；算子范数衡量它最大的拉伸倍数，算子空间配此范数成为赋范空间，目标空间完备时成为巴拿赫空间。
nodes.summaryEn: Bounded linear operators are exactly the continuous ones; the operator norm measures the largest stretching factor, and the space of operators with this norm is a Banach space whenever the target space is complete.

nodes.title: 对偶空间与里斯表示定理
nodes.titleEn: Dual Spaces and the Riesz Representation Theorem
nodes.summary: 对偶空间由全体有界线性泛函组成，永远完备；在希尔伯特空间上，每个有界线性泛函都由唯一的一个内积给出（里斯表示定理），且范数相符。
nodes.summaryEn: The dual space of all bounded linear functionals is always complete; on a Hilbert space every bounded linear functional is given by a unique inner product representation (Riesz), with equal norms.

nodes.title: 哈恩-巴拿赫定理
nodes.summary: 子空间上的线性泛函只要被次线性泛函控制，就能延拓到整个空间并保持控制；几何上它等价于凸集分离定理，是「对偶空间足够多」的根本保证。
nodes.summaryEn: A linear functional dominated by a sublinear functional on a subspace extends to the whole space while keeping the domination; geometrically it is the separation theorem for convex sets and the source of the abundance of dual functionals.

nodes.title: 开映射定理与逆算子定理
nodes.titleEn: The Open Mapping and Inverse Operator Theorems
nodes.summary: 巴拿赫空间之间连续的满射线性算子自动把开集映成开集；双射时逆算子自动有界——「满射/双射 + 完备」让连续性免费升级。
nodes.summaryEn: A bounded surjective linear operator between Banach spaces automatically maps open sets to open sets; a bounded bijection has a bounded inverse — surjectivity plus completeness upgrades continuity for free.

nodes.title: 闭图像定理与一致有界原理
nodes.titleEn: The Closed Graph Theorem and the Uniform Boundedness Principle
nodes.summary: 巴拿赫空间上图像闭的线性算子自动有界；算子族逐点有界则一致有界。加上开映射定理，它们构成泛函分析「自动连续性」的三大定理。
nodes.summaryEn: A linear operator with closed graph between Banach spaces is automatically bounded, and a pointwise bounded family of operators is uniformly bounded — together with the open mapping theorem, the automatic-continuity trio of functional analysis.

nodes.title: 紧算子
nodes.summary: 把有界集映成相对紧集的有界算子：无限维中「接近有限秩」的算子，也是谱结构最像矩阵的一类算子。
nodes.summaryEn: Bounded operators that map bounded sets to relatively compact sets: the operators closest to finite rank in infinite dimensions, and the ones whose spectra behave most like matrices.

plot.title: 紧算子的奇异值递减序列：sₙ = 1/√n，唯一聚点 0

nodes.title: 谱与预解集
nodes.summary: 使 λI−T 不存在有界逆的复数 λ 的集合：特征值概念在无限维的正确推广，它是复巴拿赫空间上的非空紧集，大小由谱半径公式控制。
nodes.summaryEn: The set of λ for which λI−T has no bounded inverse — the right infinite-dimensional generalisation of eigenvalues: a nonempty compact subset of the complex plane whose size is governed by the spectral radius formula.

plot.title: 紧正规算子谱点示意：λₙ = 0.8ⁿe^(inπ/4)，以 0 为唯一聚点

nodes.title: 自伴算子的谱定理
nodes.titleEn: The Spectral Theorem for Self-Adjoint Operators
nodes.summary: 自伴算子的谱落在实轴上且范数等于谱半径；紧自伴算子更可以像对称矩阵一样用特征向量组成标准正交基来对角化。
nodes.summaryEn: The spectrum of a self-adjoint operator lies on the real axis and its norm equals its spectral radius; a compact self-adjoint operator diagonalises along an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors, exactly like a symmetric matrix.

nodes.title: 无界算子初步
nodes.summary: 定义域只取稠密子空间、不能处处有界的算子；微分算子是原型，而 Hellinger–Toeplitz 定理表明任何无界对称算子都不可能定义在全空间上。
nodes.summaryEn: Operators defined on a proper subspace (dense by convention) rather than the whole space and unbounded there; differentiation is the paradigm, and the Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem shows that no unbounded symmetric operator can be defined on the whole space.

nodes.title: 弱收敛与自反空间
nodes.summary: 与所有连续线性泛函配对检验的收敛：比范数收敛弱，却换来自反空间中「有界序列必有弱收敛子列」的紧性。
nodes.summaryEn: Convergence tested against every continuous linear functional — weaker than norm convergence, but in exchange every bounded sequence in a reflexive space has a weakly convergent subsequence.

nodes.title: 弗雷德霍姆二择一定理
nodes.summary: 对紧算子与 λ≠0，方程 (λI−T)x=y 要么对每个 y 唯一可解，要么齐次方程有非零解（此时非齐次方程无解或有无穷多解）；等价地，紧算子的非零谱点全是特征值。
nodes.summaryEn: For a compact operator T and λ≠0, the equation (λI−T)x=y either has a unique solution for every y, or the homogeneous equation has a nonzero solution (then the equation has either no solution or infinitely many); equivalently, every nonzero spectral point of a compact operator is an eigenvalue.

nodes.title: 解的最大存在区间与延拓
nodes.titleEn: Maximal Interval of Existence and Continuation
nodes.summary: 皮卡定理只保证局部解；把解一段段延拓直到离开定义域，就得到最大存在区间。有限端点处解必定爆破，或趋于 $f$ 的定义域边界：y' = y²、y(0) = 1 的解在 t = 1 爆破。线性方程整体存在，非线性方程可能有限时间爆破。
nodes.summaryEn: Picard's theorem guarantees only a local solution; continuing it until it leaves the domain gives the maximal interval of existence. A finite endpoint forces blow-up — the solution of y' = y², y(0) = 1 explodes at t = 1. Linear equations exist globally, nonlinear ones may not.

plot.title: y' = y² 的斜率场：解 y = 1/(1−x) 在 x = 1 处爆破，最大存在区间的右端点就是爆破时刻

nodes.title: 解对初值与参数的连续依赖性和可微性
nodes.titleEn: Continuous Dependence on Initial Conditions and Parameters
nodes.summary: 解对初值与参数的连续依赖性由 Gronwall 不等式给出指数型误差控制；可微性由第一变分方程刻画，是适定性、灵敏度分析与打靶法的基石。
nodes.summaryEn: Continuous dependence on initial data and parameters is quantified by Gronwall's inequality as exponential error control; differentiability is governed by the first variation equation — the basis of well-posedness, sensitivity analysis and shooting methods.

nodes.title: 比较定理与微分不等式
nodes.summary: 比较定理：斜率函数有序、初值有序，解就永远有序。微分不等式与上解/下解把无法求解的方程夹在可解方程之间，是估计爆破时间与证明存在性的基本工具。
nodes.summaryEn: The comparison theorem: ordered slope functions and ordered initial data keep solutions ordered. Differential inequalities and sub/supersolutions squeeze an unsolvable equation between two solvable ones — the basic tool for existence proofs and blow-up estimates.

plot.title: y' = 0.5y：初值有序则解始终有序，两条解曲线永不相交（比较原理的最简情形）

nodes.title: 常微分方程的边值问题
nodes.titleEn: Boundary Value Problems for Ordinary Differential Equations
nodes.summary: 条件加在区间两端的边值问题：解可能不存在、唯一存在或有无穷多个；特征值 λₙ = (nπ/L)² 刻画共振，格林函数与弗雷德霍姆二择一是求解与判定的核心工具。
nodes.summaryEn: Boundary value problems place conditions at both ends of an interval: a solution may fail to exist, be unique, or form an infinite family. Eigenvalues λₙ=(nπ/L)² mark resonance; Green's functions and the Fredholm alternative are the main tools.

plot.title: y'' + λy = 0, y(0) = y(π) = 0 的前三个特征函数：sin x、sin 2x、sin 3x（特征值 λ = n²）

nodes.title: 李雅普诺夫第二方法与李雅普诺夫函数
nodes.titleEn: Lyapunov's Second Method and Lyapunov Functions
nodes.summary: 不求解方程，只找一个正定函数 V 并考察它沿轨线的导数 V̇ = ∇V·f 的符号，就能判定平衡点的稳定、渐近稳定与不稳定。
nodes.summaryEn: Without solving the equation, find a positive definite function V and read the sign of its orbital derivative V̇ = ∇V·f to decide stability, asymptotic stability or instability of an equilibrium.

plot.title: 李雅普诺夫函数 V = x² + y² 的等值线：闭曲线层层包围原点

nodes.title: 动力系统初步：流、轨道与不变集
nodes.titleEn: Introduction to Dynamical Systems: Flows, Orbits and Invariant Sets
nodes.summary: 把微分方程的解看成随时间演化的流 φ_t：由群性质、轨道与不变集、ω-极限集这套语言，统一刻画系统的长期行为与最终归宿。
nodes.summaryEn: View solutions as a flow φ_t: the language of orbits, invariant sets and ω-limit sets captures where the dynamics ends up in the long run.

plot.title: 中心相图 x' = y, y' = -x：每个圆形轨道都是不变集

nodes.title: 极限环与庞加莱-本迪克松定理
nodes.titleEn: Limit Cycles and the Poincaré–Bendixson Theorem
nodes.summary: 孤立的闭轨称为极限环，代表与初值无关的自激振荡；庞加莱–本迪克松定理给出平面上闭轨的存在判据，Bendixson 判据则给出排除闭轨的方法。
nodes.summaryEn: Isolated closed orbits are limit cycles — self-sustained oscillations independent of initial data; the Poincaré–Bendixson theorem gives an existence criterion and Bendixson's criterion a way to rule closed orbits out.

plot.title: 范德波尔振子 μ = 1：轨线被吸引到唯一的极限环

nodes.title: 分支与混沌初步
nodes.summary: 参数变化引起相图拓扑结构突变就是分支：鞍结、跨临界、叉式、Hopf 是四种基本类型；混沌是确定性系统中的敏感依赖，平面自治系统不会混沌。
nodes.summaryEn: A bifurcation is a qualitative change of the phase portrait as a parameter varies — saddle-node, transcritical, pitchfork and Hopf are the basic types; chaos is sensitive dependence in a deterministic system, impossible in the planar autonomous case.

plot.title: x' = ax − x³ 的平衡点：y = x³ 与 y = ax 的交点随 a 变化

nodes.title: 空间曲线与参数表示
nodes.summary: 用参数 t 描述空间中运动质点的轨迹：r(t) = (x(t), y(t), z(t))；处处满足 r′(t) ≠ 0 的曲线称为正则曲线。
nodes.summaryEn: A moving point in space described by a parameter: r(t) = (x(t), y(t), z(t)); the curve is regular when r′(t) ≠ 0 everywhere.

plot.title: 圆柱螺线 r(t) = (cos t, sin t, t/3)

nodes.title: 弧长与弧长参数化
nodes.summary: 弧长 s(t) = ∫ₐᵗ |r′(τ)| dτ 是曲线的自然参数：用弧长作参数后速率恒为 1，即 |r′| ≡ 1。
nodes.summaryEn: Arc length s(t) = ∫ₐᵗ |r′(τ)| dτ is the natural parameter: after reparametrizing by arc length the speed is always 1, |r′| ≡ 1.

plot.title: 平面曲线 r(t) = (t, sin t, 0)：弧长由 ∫|r′| dt 累计

nodes.title: Frenet 标架
nodes.summary: 曲线上每点由单位切向量 T、主法向量 N、副法向量 B 组成的右手正交标架：T = r′/|r′|，N = T′/|T′|，B = T × N。
nodes.summaryEn: At every point, the right-handed orthonormal frame T = r′/|r′|, N = T′/|T′|, B = T × N: tangent, principal normal, binormal.

plot.title: 螺线上的 Frenet 标架：T（粉）、N（绿）、B（黄）

nodes.title: 曲率与挠率
nodes.summary: 曲率 κ = |T′|/|r′| = |r′ × r″|/|r′|³ 度量弯曲的快慢；挠率 τ = (r′, r″, r‴)/|r′ × r″|² 度量扭出密切平面的快慢。
nodes.summaryEn: Curvature κ = |T′|/|r′| = |r′ × r″|/|r′|³ measures how fast the curve bends; torsion τ = (r′, r″, r‴)/|r′ × r″|² measures how fast it twists out of the osculating plane.

plot.title: 圆柱螺线：κ = a/(a²+b²) 与 τ = b/(a²+b²) 均为常数

nodes.title: Frenet–Serret 公式
nodes.summary: 描述标架随弧长转动的微分方程：T′ = κN，N′ = −κT + τB，B′ = −τN（一般参数下每项乘 v = |r′|）。
nodes.summaryEn: The ODEs describing how the frame rotates along the curve: T′ = κN, N′ = −κT + τB, B′ = −τN (with v = |r′| multiplying each term for a general parameter).

plot.title: Frenet 标架在曲线上两点的位置：标架随弧长转动

nodes.title: 曲线论基本定理
nodes.titleEn: The Fundamental Theorem of Curve Theory
nodes.summary: 给定连续函数 κ(s) > 0 与 τ(s)，存在以它们为曲率与挠率的曲线，并且在刚体运动意义下唯一。
nodes.summaryEn: Given continuous functions κ(s) > 0 and τ(s), there exists a curve with these curvature and torsion, unique up to a rigid motion.

plot.title: 螺线：κ、τ 恒定，形状被它们完全决定

nodes.title: 正则曲面与参数表示
nodes.summary: 用两个参数的光滑映射 r(u,v) 铺出一张曲面，并要求 r_u、r_v 处处线性无关（r_u × r_v ≠ 0）——这条正则性条件保证每点都有切平面，是微分几何一切计算的起点。
nodes.summaryEn: A surface swept out by a smooth two-parameter map r(u,v) with r_u and r_v linearly independent everywhere (r_u × r_v ≠ 0) — the regularity condition guaranteeing a tangent plane at every point, and the starting point of every computation in differential geometry.

plot.title: 单位球面的参数网 r(u,v)：u 为极角、v 为方位角，极点处参数网退化

nodes.title: 切平面与法向量
nodes.summary: 曲面上过一点的所有曲线切向量拼成二维切平面，它由 r_u、r_v 张成；垂直于它的单位法向量 n = (r_u × r_v)/|r_u × r_v| 是刻画曲面取向与一切曲率计算的基本工具。
nodes.summaryEn: The velocity vectors of all curves on a surface through a point span the two-dimensional tangent plane generated by r_u and r_v; the unit normal n = (r_u × r_v)/|r_u × r_v| perpendicular to it is the basic tool for orientation and for every curvature computation.

plot.title: 马鞍面 z = x² − y²：每点的切平面由 r_u、r_v 张成

nodes.title: 第一基本形式
nodes.summary: I = E du² + 2F dudv + G dv²，其中 E = r_u·r_u、F = r_u·r_v、G = r_v·r_v；它把曲面的内蕴几何——长度、夹角、面积——全部编码进一个二次型，等价于 ds²。
nodes.summaryEn: The quadratic form I = E du² + 2F dudv + G dv², with E = r_u·r_u, F = r_u·r_v and G = r_v·r_v, encoding the intrinsic geometry of the surface — lengths, angles, area — in a single quadratic form; it is the same thing as ds².

plot.title: 单位球面：E = 1、F = 0、G = sin²u，面积元 √(EG−F²) = sin u

nodes.title: 曲面的面积
nodes.summary: 用参数网把曲面切成小片，每片近似为以 r_u du、r_v dv 为边的平行四边形，面积是 |r_u × r_v| dudv = √(EG−F²) dudv；累加取极限得 A = ∬_D √(EG−F²) dudv。
nodes.summaryEn: The parameter grid cuts the surface into small pieces, each approximated by a parallelogram spanned by r_u du and r_v dv with area |r_u × r_v| dudv = √(EG−F²) dudv; summing and passing to the limit gives A = ∬_D √(EG−F²) dudv.

plot.title: 环面 R=2、r=0.7：面积 = ∬√(EG−F²) dudv = 4π²Rr ≈ 55.3

nodes.title: 第二基本形式
nodes.summary: II = L du² + 2M dudv + N dv²，其中 L = r_uu·n、M = r_uv·n、N = r_vv·n；它描述曲面在空间中如何「离开」自己的切平面（外蕴弯曲），与第一基本形式一道给出法曲率与主曲率。
nodes.summaryEn: The quadratic form II = L du² + 2M dudv + N dv² with L = r_uu·n, M = r_uv·n, N = r_vv·n; it describes how the surface leaves its tangent plane in space (extrinsic bending) and, together with the first fundamental form, yields normal and principal curvatures.

plot.title: 马鞍面 z = x² − y²：L、M、N 度量它如何离开切平面（原点 L=2、N=−2）

nodes.title: 法曲率
nodes.summary: 沿切方向 (du:dv) 的法曲率 κ_n = II/I = (L du² + 2M dudv + N dv²)/(E du² + 2F dudv + G dv²)，等于过该点切于此方向的曲线曲率在法向上的投影；球面各方向 κ_n = ±1/R，平面 κ_n ≡ 0。
nodes.summaryEn: Along a tangent direction (du:dv) the normal curvature is κ_n = II/I = (L du² + 2M dudv + N dv²)/(E du² + 2F dudv + G dv²), the projection of a suitable curve's curvature onto the surface normal; on a sphere κ_n = ±1/R in every direction, while a plane has κ_n ≡ 0.

plot.title: 球面：任意方向的法曲率都是常数 |κₙ| = 1/R（本库取外向 n 时 κₙ = −1/R）

nodes.title: 正弦定理
nodes.summary: 三角形中边与对角正弦的比值相等，都等于外接圆直径。
nodes.summaryEn: In any triangle the ratio of a side to the sine of its opposite angle is the same, equal to the circumdiameter.

plot.title: 任意三角形中的正弦定理

nodes.title: 余弦定理
nodes.summary: 三角形中一边的平方等于另两边的平方和减去它们与夹角余弦的二倍积。
nodes.summaryEn: The square of one side equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides minus twice their product times the cosine of the included angle.

plot.title: 三角形中的余弦定理（边与夹角）

nodes.title: 三角形的面积
nodes.summary: 三角形的面积可由底乘高、两边夹一角或三边长度等多种方式计算。
nodes.summaryEn: A triangle's area can be computed from base and height, from two sides and the included angle, or from three sides.

plot.title: 三角形面积：底乘高除以二

nodes.title: 解三角形的实际应用
nodes.summary: 用正弦、余弦定理解决测距、测高、测量角度等实际问题。
nodes.summaryEn: Using the laws of sines and cosines to solve real-world distance, height and angle measurement problems.

plot.title: 测高模型：由距离与仰角求高度

nodes.title: 反三角函数
nodes.summary: 由三角函数值反求角度的函数，包括 arcsin、arccos 和 arctan。
nodes.summaryEn: Functions that recover an angle from a trigonometric value: arcsin, arccos and arctan.

plot.title: 反三角函数图像（arcsin / arccos / arctan）

nodes.title: 辅助角公式
nodes.summary: 把 a sin x + b cos x 合并成一个正弦型函数 R sin(x+φ)。
nodes.summaryEn: Combining a sin x + b cos x into a single sine wave R sin(x+φ).

plot.title: 辅助角公式：两条曲线完全重合

nodes.title: 正弦型函数模型
nodes.summary: 形如 y = A sin(ωx + φ) + k 的函数，用来描述各种周期现象。
nodes.summaryEn: A function of the form y = A sin(ωx + φ) + k, used to model periodic phenomena.

plot.title: 正弦型函数 y = 2sin(3x+1) 与 y = sin x 的对比

nodes.title: 三角形中的恒等变换
nodes.summary: 利用 A+B+C=π 推出的三角形内角关系式，如 sin(A+B)=sin C。
nodes.summaryEn: Identities among the angles of a triangle derived from A+B+C=π, such as sin(A+B)=sin C.

plot.title: 三角形内角关系 A + B + C = π

nodes.title: 勾股定理与三角
nodes.summary: 直角三角形中两直角边平方和等于斜边平方，是三角比与余弦定理的基础。
nodes.summaryEn: In a right triangle the sum of the squares of the legs equals the square of the hypotenuse, the basis of trigonometric ratios and the law of cosines.

plot.title: 直角三角形与勾股定理（3-4-5）

nodes.title: 和差化积与积化和差
nodes.summary: 在三角函数的和差形式与乘积形式之间互相转化的恒等式。
nodes.summaryEn: Identities converting between sums and differences of trigonometric functions and their products.

plot.title: 和差化积：两条曲线完全重合

nodes.title: 高斯曲率与平均曲率
nodes.summary: 温加滕映射（形状算子）W=−dn 的两个特征值 κ₁、κ₂ 刻画出曲面在两个主方向的弯曲：K=κ₁κ₂ 是内蕴的高斯曲率，H=(κ₁+κ₂)/2 是外蕴的平均曲率。
nodes.summaryEn: The two eigenvalues κ₁, κ₂ of the Weingarten map (shape operator) W = −dn describe how a surface bends: K = κ₁κ₂ is the intrinsic Gaussian curvature and H = (κ₁+κ₂)/2 the extrinsic mean curvature.

plot.title: 环面：外侧 K>0、内侧 K<0、上下两圆 K=0

nodes.title: 主曲率与主方向
nodes.summary: 形状算子的特征值 κ₁、κ₂（主曲率）与特征方向（主方向）把曲面每点的弯曲分解为两个互相垂直方向的纯弯曲：它们是法曲率的最大值与最小值。
nodes.summaryEn: The eigenvalues κ₁, κ₂ of the shape operator (principal curvatures) and its eigenvectors (principal directions) split the bending at each point into two perpendicular pure bendings: they are the maximum and minimum of the normal curvature.

plot.title: 马鞍面：原点处 κ₁=2、κ₂=−2，两主方向为 x、y 方向

nodes.title: 高斯映射
nodes.summary: 高斯映射把曲面上每一点映成它的单位法向量的终点，得到单位球面上的点；它的微分就是差一个符号的形状算子，其行列式恰为高斯曲率。
nodes.summaryEn: The Gauss map sends each point of a surface to the tip of its unit normal, a point of the unit sphere; its differential is the shape operator up to sign, and its Jacobian determinant is exactly the Gaussian curvature.

plot.title: 高斯映射 n: S → S²：把单位法向量的终点画在单位球面上

nodes.title: 高斯绝妙定理
nodes.summary: 高斯绝妙定理：高斯曲率 K 只由第一基本形式（度量 E、F、G 及其导数）决定，与第二基本形式无关 —— 所以 K 是内蕴量，等距变换保持 K。
nodes.summaryEn: The Theorema Egregium: the Gaussian curvature K depends only on the first fundamental form (the metric E, F, G and their derivatives), not on the second fundamental form, so K is intrinsic and preserved by isometries.

plot.title: 球面 K≡1/R²>0 不能等距摊平；柱面 K≡0 则可展

nodes.title: 测地线
nodes.summary: 测地线是曲面上「尽量直」的曲线：测地曲率 κ_g=0，曲率向量平行于曲面法向；它也是局部最短线 —— 球面上是大圆，柱面上是螺旋线。
nodes.summaryEn: A geodesic is the straightest curve on a surface: its geodesic curvature vanishes and its curvature vector is parallel to the surface normal; it is locally shortest — great circles on a sphere, helices on a cylinder.

plot.title: 圆柱面：螺旋线（含母线）是测地线

nodes.title: 高斯–博内定理
nodes.summary: 区域内部的曲率积分 ∬K dA 加上边界测地曲率积分 ∮κ_g ds 等于 2π 乘欧拉示性数；闭曲面的总曲率是纯拓扑不变量（球面 4π、环面 0）。
nodes.summaryEn: The Gauss–Bonnet theorem: the total curvature ∬K dA of a region plus the geodesic curvature integral ∮κ_g ds along its boundary equals 2π times the Euler characteristic; the total curvature of a closed surface is a topological invariant (4π for the sphere, 0 for the torus).

plot.title: 环面 χ=0：外侧 K>0 与内侧 K<0 恰好抵消，∬K dA=0

nodes.title: 光滑流形
nodes.summary: 每点附近都同胚于欧氏空间、局部坐标之间又光滑衔接的拓扑空间；有了它，微积分才能搬上弯曲的空间。
nodes.summaryEn: A topological space that looks locally like Euclidean space with smooth transitions between local coordinate systems — the stage on which calculus is done on curved spaces.

nodes.title: 切空间与切映射
nodes.summary: 流形在一点的线性化：切向量可以用过该点曲线的等价类定义，也可以定义为满足莱布尼茨法则的导子；光滑映射的切映射 $df_p$ 在坐标下就是雅可比矩阵。
nodes.summaryEn: The linearization of a manifold at a point: tangent vectors as equivalence classes of curves or as derivations obeying Leibniz's rule, with the differential $df_p$ given by the Jacobian in coordinates.

plot.title: 切空间 T_pM：球面 S² 与它在北极 p 处的切平面（平面只在 p 与球面相切）

nodes.title: 流形上的向量场与流
nodes.titleEn: Vector Fields and Flows on Manifolds
nodes.summary: 光滑地给流形每点指定一个切向量：向量场与 $C^\infty(M)$ 上一阶导子一一对应，积分曲线由 ODE 存在唯一性定理生成局部流，紧流形上一切向量场都完备。
nodes.summaryEn: Smoothly assigning a tangent vector to every point: vector fields correspond to derivations of $C^\infty(M)$, their integral curves generate local flows by ODE existence and uniqueness, and every vector field on a compact manifold is complete.

plot.title: 旋转场 X = (−y, x)：积分曲线是同心圆，流即旋转，对一切 t ∈ ℝ 有定义（完备）

nodes.title: 微分形式
nodes.summary: 每点给出一个反对称 $k$ 重线性函数的场：0-形式是函数，1-形式是余切向量场；外积满足分次交换律 $\alpha \wedge \beta = (-1)^{|\alpha||\beta|} \beta \wedge \alpha$，是格林、斯托克斯、高斯公式统一语言的载体。
nodes.summaryEn: Fields assigning an alternating $k$-linear function to each point: 0-forms are functions, 1-forms are covector fields, and the wedge product is graded-commutative—the language that unifies Green, Stokes and Gauss theorems.

nodes.title: 外微分
nodes.summary: 把 $k$-形式映为 $(k+1)$-形式的唯一算子 $d$：线性、满足分次莱布尼茨律 $d(\omega \wedge \eta) = d\omega \wedge \eta + (-1)^{|\omega|}\omega \wedge d\eta$、$d^2 = 0$，对函数就是普通微分；闭形式与恰当形式的差别由流形拓扑决定。
nodes.summaryEn: The unique operator d taking k-forms to (k+1)-forms: linear, satisfying the graded Leibniz rule and d² = 0, agreeing with the ordinary differential on functions; the gap between closed and exact forms reflects the topology of the manifold.

nodes.title: 流形上的积分与定向
nodes.summary: 在可定向流形上积分微分形式：局部就是系数函数的普通重积分，换坐标时用带符号的雅可比行列式，因此积分只依赖定向、不依赖坐标卡；不可定向的莫比乌斯带连体积形式都没有。
nodes.summaryEn: Integrating differential forms on an oriented manifold: locally it is the ordinary multiple integral of the coefficient, with the signed Jacobian in a change of coordinates, so the integral depends only on the orientation and not on the chart; the non-orientable Möbius band admits no volume form at all.

nodes.title: 广义斯托克斯定理
nodes.summary: ∫_M dω = ∫_∂M ω：一个公式统一牛顿—莱布尼茨、格林、经典斯托克斯与高斯公式，是外微分与边界在积分层面的完整表达。
nodes.summaryEn: ∫_M dω = ∫_∂M ω: one formula unifying the Newton–Leibniz formula, Green's theorem, the classical Stokes theorem and the divergence theorem — the integral-level expression of d together with the boundary.

nodes.title: 李导数与李括号
nodes.summary: 沿向量场的流对几何对象求导：按定义就是流的拉回对时间的导数，计算上由嘉当魔法公式 L_X = dι_X + ι_X d 主宰，而在向量场上它化为大家熟悉的李括号 [X,Y]。
nodes.summaryEn: Differentiating geometric objects along the flow of a vector field: by definition it is the time derivative of the flow pullback, computed in practice via Cartan's magic formula L_X = dι_X + ι_X d, and on vector fields it reduces to the Lie bracket [X,Y].

plot.title: 旋转场 X=(−y, x)：流沿圆周旋转，圆 x²+y²=const 是流的不变集

nodes.title: 等距与可展曲面
nodes.summary: 等距是保持第一基本形式（从而保持曲面上曲线长度）的映射；能与平面建立等距对应的曲面恰是高斯曲率恒为零的可展曲面，如柱面、锥面与切线面。
nodes.summaryEn: An isometry is a map preserving the first fundamental form, hence the lengths of curves on the surface; the surfaces that are locally isometric to the plane are exactly the developable ones, characterised by vanishing Gaussian curvature, such as cylinders, cones and tangent developables.

plot.title: 柱面 r(u,v)=(cos u, sin u, v)：I=du²+dv² 与平面相同，K≡0（可展）

nodes.title: 极小曲面
nodes.summary: 平均曲率恒为零的曲面：面积泛函的驻点、肥皂膜的数学模型；悬链面与螺旋面是最经典的两个例子，而且二者局部等距。
nodes.summaryEn: Surfaces with identically vanishing mean curvature: the stationary points of the area functional and the mathematical model of soap films; the catenoid and the helicoid are the two classical examples, locally isometric to each other.

plot.title: 螺旋面 r(u,v)=(u cos v, u sin v, v)：H≡0 的极小曲面，K=−1/(1+u²)²

nodes.title: 有理数
nodes.summary: 整数和分数统称有理数；用数轴、相反数与绝对值把「大小、方向、距离」一次看清楚。
nodes.summaryEn: Integers and fractions together form the rational numbers; the number line, opposites and absolute value show size, direction and distance at a glance.

plot.title: 数轴上的有理数：-2、0、1.5，以及从 -2 到 1.5 的区间

nodes.title: 有理数的运算
nodes.summary: 加减乘除与乘方的法则，加上「先乘方、再乘除、最后加减」的运算顺序；符号法则是全部计算的命门。
nodes.summaryEn: The rules for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and powers, together with the order of operations; getting the signs right is the key to every computation.

nodes.title: 科学记数法与近似数
nodes.summary: 用 a×10^n（1≤|a|<10）把很大或很小的数写得简洁，并认识近似数的精确度与有效数字。
nodes.summaryEn: Writing very large or very small numbers compactly as a×10ⁿ (1 ≤ |a| < 10), and understanding the accuracy and significant figures of approximate numbers.

nodes.title: 平方根与立方根
nodes.summary: 开方是乘方的逆运算：正数有两个互为相反数的平方根，算术平方根非负，而任何实数都有唯一的立方根。
nodes.summaryEn: Root extraction inverts powers: a positive number has two square roots that are opposites, the arithmetic square root is never negative, and every real number has exactly one cube root.

plot.title: y = x² 与 y = √x：开方与乘方互为逆运算

nodes.title: 实数
nodes.summary: 有理数与无理数（无限不循环小数）统称实数，实数与数轴上的点一一对应；√2 是无理数可用反证法证明。
nodes.summaryEn: Rational numbers together with irrational numbers (infinite non-repeating decimals) form the real numbers, in one-to-one correspondence with the points of the number line; √2 is irrational, provable by contradiction.

plot.title: 无理数 √2 与 π 在数轴上的近似位置

nodes.title: 整式与合并同类项
nodes.summary: 单项式与多项式统称整式；同类项要求字母与指数完全相同，合并时只把系数相加，去括号要看括号前的符号。
nodes.summaryEn: Monomials and polynomials make up integral expressions; like terms must match in letters and exponents, combining them only adds the coefficients, and removing brackets depends on the sign in front.

nodes.title: 整式的乘法与乘法公式
nodes.titleEn: Multiplication of Polynomials and Algebraic Identities
nodes.summary: 整式相乘的运算法则，以及平方差、完全平方等核心乘法公式——因式分解的「正过程」。
nodes.summaryEn: The rules for multiplying polynomials and the core identities (difference of squares, perfect squares) — the forward direction of factorization.

plot.title: (a+b)² = a² + 2ab + b² 的正方形面积模型

nodes.title: 因式分解
nodes.summary: 把多项式化成几个整式的积——整式乘法的逆变形，也是解方程、化简分式的基础工具。
nodes.summaryEn: Rewriting a polynomial as a product of factors — the inverse of expansion and the key tool for solving equations and simplifying fractions.

plot.title: 两条曲线完全重合：因式分解不改变式子的值

nodes.title: 分式
nodes.summary: 分母中含字母的式子（形如 A/B 且 B≠0）——运算与分数相似，但每一步都要盯住「分母不为 0」。
nodes.summaryEn: Expressions of the form A/B with a letter in the denominator — they work like fractions, but the denominator must never be zero.

plot.title: y = 1/x：x ≠ 0，两条分支分别向坐标轴靠近

nodes.title: 二次根式
nodes.summary: 形如 √a（a ≥ 0）的式子——被开方数必须非负，化简靠积、商的算术平方根，只有同类二次根式才能合并。
nodes.summaryEn: Expressions of the form √a with a ≥ 0 — the radicand must be nonnegative, simplification uses the root of a product or quotient, and only like radicals can be combined.

plot.title: y = √x：定义域 x ≥ 0，图像从原点出发并上升

nodes.title: 一元一次方程
nodes.summary: 只含一个未知数、未知数次数都是 1 的方程，形如 ax+b=0（a≠0）——解的唯一关键是「移项变号」。
nodes.summaryEn: An equation in one unknown of degree 1, of the form ax + b = 0 (a ≠ 0); the key step is transposing terms while changing their signs.

plot.title: 方程 (x+1)/2 - (x-2)/3 = 1 的解是数轴上的一个点：x = -1

nodes.title: 二元一次方程组
nodes.titleEn: Systems of Linear Equations in Two Variables
nodes.summary: 把两个二元一次方程联立起来——用代入或加减消元求解，解就是两条直线交点的坐标。
nodes.summaryEn: Two linear equations in two unknowns taken together — solve them by substitution or elimination; the solution is the intersection point of two lines.

plot.title: 方程组的解就是两条直线的交点：(3, 2)

nodes.title: 一元一次不等式与不等式组
nodes.titleEn: Linear Inequalities in One Variable and Their Systems
nodes.summary: 含一个未知数、次数为 1 的不等式：两边加（减）同一数方向不变，乘（除）负数必须改变方向；不等式组的解集是各解集的公共部分，可在数轴上用实心点、空心圈表示。
nodes.summaryEn: An inequality with one unknown of degree 1: adding or subtracting keeps the direction, while multiplying or dividing by a negative number reverses it; a system's solution set is the common part of the individual ones, shown on a number line with solid dots and open circles.

plot.title: 2 < x ≤ 3：端点 2 画空心圈（不含），端点 3 画实心点（含）

nodes.title: 一元二次方程
nodes.summary: 只含一个未知数、最高次数为 2 的整式方程，一般形式 ax²+bx+c=0（a≠0）；可用直接开平方、配方、公式、因式分解求解，判别式 Δ=b²−4ac 决定实数根的情况。
nodes.summaryEn: A polynomial equation of degree 2 in one unknown, written as ax²+bx+c=0 (a≠0); it can be solved by square roots, completing the square, the quadratic formula or factoring, while Δ=b²−4ac decides the real roots.

tangents.label: 与 x 轴交点 x = −1
与 x 轴交点 x = 3

nodes.title: 反比例函数
nodes.summary: 形如 y=k/x（k≠0）的函数：图像是双曲线，两支关于原点对称、与坐标轴永不相交；k>0 时在第一、三象限，k<0 时在第二、四象限，矩形面积恒等于 |k|。
nodes.summaryEn: A function of the form y=k/x (k≠0): its graph is a hyperbola whose two branches are centrally symmetric about the origin and never meet the axes; k>0 puts them in quadrants I and III, k<0 in II and IV, and the rectangle area equals |k|.

plot.title: 反比例函数的两支双曲线：关于原点对称，与坐标轴永不相交

nodes.title: 锐角三角函数
nodes.summary: 直角三角形中锐角的对边、邻边与斜边之比：正弦、余弦、正切；角一定则比值一定，特殊角的值与同角关系、互余关系是解题基础。
nodes.summaryEn: Ratios among the opposite side, adjacent side and hypotenuse of an acute angle in a right triangle: sine, cosine and tangent; once the angle is fixed the ratios are fixed, and the special values together with the same-angle and complementary-angle relations are the tools for solving right triangles.

plot.title: Rt△ABC（∠C = 90°）：sinA = a/c，cosA = b/c，tanA = a/b

nodes.title: 数据的收集、整理与描述
nodes.summary: 收集数据要分清全面调查与抽样调查，理解总体、个体、样本与样本容量；整理时统计频数与频率（频率之和为 1），再用合适的统计图描述数据。
nodes.summaryEn: Collecting data requires telling a census from a sample survey and understanding population, individual, sample and sample size; data are then organized by frequency and relative frequency (which add up to 1) and described with suitable charts.

nodes.title: 数据的分析
nodes.summary: 用平均数（含加权平均数）、中位数、众数刻画数据的集中趋势，用方差描述数据的波动大小，并根据实际需要选择合适的统计量。
nodes.summaryEn: The mean (including the weighted mean), median and mode describe the central tendency of data, while the variance measures how widely the data scatter; suitable statistics are chosen according to the question.

plot.title: 中位数 = (5+7)/2 = 6（偶数个数据取中间两个的平均数）

nodes.title: 平面直角坐标系
nodes.summary: 用一对有序实数确定平面内点的位置，把「形」的问题变成「数」的问题。
nodes.summaryEn: A system that locates every point of the plane by an ordered pair of numbers, turning shape problems into number problems.

plot.title: 平面直角坐标系：四个象限与点的坐标

nodes.title: 直线、射线、线段与角
nodes.summary: 认识直线、射线、线段的区别，理解角、余角与补角，是平面几何的第一块基石。
nodes.summaryEn: The difference between lines, rays and segments, and the basics of angles, complements and supplements — the first building blocks of plane geometry.

elements.text: 两端无限延伸，不可度量
一端无限延伸，不可度量
角：由两条有公共端点的射线组成

plot.title: 直线、射线、线段与角

nodes.title: 相交线与平行线
nodes.summary: 对顶角相等、邻补角互补；平行线的判定与性质方向相反，是最经典的易错点。
nodes.summaryEn: Vertical angles are equal and adjacent supplementary angles add to 180°; the test for parallel lines and their property run in opposite directions — a classic source of mistakes.

elements.text: 两条直线相交，形成四个角
点到直线的距离 = 垂线段长度
两直线被第三条直线所截
a ∥ b 时：同位角、内错角相等

plot.title: 相交线与平行线：对顶角、邻补角与三线八角

nodes.title: 全等三角形
nodes.summary: 形状、大小完全相同的两个三角形；用 SSS、SAS、ASA、AAS、HL 判定，SSA 与 AAA 都不行。
nodes.summaryEn: Two triangles with exactly the same shape and size; proved by SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS or HL — SSA and AAA never work.

elements.text: 对应边相等：相同短划线标记的两条边相等

plot.title: 全等三角形：对应边相等（短划线标记）

nodes.title: 轴对称
nodes.summary: 图形沿一条直线折叠后两旁重合；对称轴是直线，对应点连线被对称轴垂直平分。
nodes.summaryEn: A figure folds onto itself across a line; the axis is a line, and it perpendicularly bisects the segment joining a point to its image.

elements.text: 对应点连线被对称轴垂直平分

plot.title: 轴对称：两个图形成轴对称（对应点连线被垂直平分）

nodes.title: 旋转与中心对称
nodes.summary: 旋转由中心、方向、角度三要素决定；绕定点旋转 180° 就是中心对称。
nodes.summaryEn: A rotation is fixed by its centre, direction and angle; a 180° turn about a point is central symmetry.

elements.text: △ABC 与 △A′B′C′ 关于原点 O 中心对称
对称点连线都经过对称中心 O，且被 O 平分

plot.title: 旋转与中心对称：绕原点旋转 180°

nodes.title: 平行四边形
nodes.summary: 两组对边分别平行的四边形；对边相等、对角相等、对角线互相平分，是中心对称图形。
nodes.summaryEn: A quadrilateral whose two pairs of opposite sides are parallel; opposite sides and angles are equal and the diagonals bisect each other.

elements.text: OA = OC，OB = OD（对角线互相平分）

plot.title: 平行四边形与它的两条对角线

nodes.title: 矩形、菱形与正方形
nodes.summary: 三种特殊的平行四边形：矩形四个角是直角、菱形四条边相等、正方形既是矩形又是菱形。
nodes.summaryEn: Three special parallelograms: a rectangle has four right angles, a rhombus has four equal sides, and a square is both.

elements.text: 矩形：四个直角，对角线相等
菱形：四边相等，对角线垂直

plot.title: 平行四边形家族：矩形、菱形与正方形

nodes.title: 圆
nodes.summary: 到定点距离等于定长的点的集合；垂径定理、圆周角定理、切线、弧长与扇形面积是核心内容。
nodes.summaryEn: The set of all points at a fixed distance from a fixed point; key results include the perpendicular-diameter theorem, the inscribed angle theorem, tangents, and arc and sector formulas.

elements.text: 圆周角 ∠ACB = 圆心角 ∠AOB 的一半

plot.title: 圆：半径、弦与圆周角

nodes.title: 相似三角形
nodes.summary: 对应角相等、对应边成比例的三角形；判定有 AA、SAS、SSS，周长比等于相似比、面积比等于相似比的平方。
nodes.summaryEn: Triangles with equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides; AA, SAS and SSS criteria; perimeter ratio equals the similarity ratio while area ratio equals its square.

elements.text: 周长比 = k，面积比 = k²

plot.title: 两个相似三角形（一大一小）

nodes.title: 投影与视图
nodes.summary: 平行投影与中心投影；三视图从正面、左面、上面看几何体，遵循「长对正、高平齐、宽相等」。
nodes.summaryEn: Parallel and central projections; the three views (front, left, top) of a solid satisfy length alignment, height alignment and width equality.

elements.text: 长对正 · 高平齐 · 宽相等

plot.title: 长方体的三视图（长对正、高平齐、宽相等）

nodes.title: 数数与比较大小
nodes.summary: 数数就是把东西一个一个数出来；比较大小就是看哪个多、哪个少，在数轴上越往右的数越大。
nodes.summaryEn: Counting matches objects one by one with number words; comparing tells us which group is more, and on the number line numbers grow to the right.

nodes.title: 整数的认识与数位
nodes.summary: 整数用数字和数位写出来：从右边起是个位、十位、百位、千位……每相邻两个计数单位之间的进率都是 10。
nodes.summaryEn: Whole numbers are written with digits and place value: from the right come the ones, tens, hundreds and thousands places, and every two neighbouring counting units differ by a factor of 10.

plot.title: 满十进一：9 再添 1 就是 10——个位写 0、十位进 1，10 就是「1 个十」

nodes.title: 加法和减法
nodes.summary: 加法把两个数合并成一个数，减法从和里去掉一个加数求另一个加数；减法是加法的逆运算，算完要记得验算。
nodes.summaryEn: Addition puts two numbers together into one, and subtraction takes one addend out of the sum to find the other; subtraction is the inverse operation of addition, and checking your work is easy.

plot.title: 在数轴上算 3+4：向右跳 3 格，再向右跳 4 格，落到 7

nodes.title: 乘法和除法
nodes.summary: 乘法是求几个相同加数的和的简便运算，除法是乘法的逆运算；有余数时余数要比除数小，0 不能作除数。
nodes.summaryEn: Multiplication is a short way to add equal numbers, division is its inverse operation, and in division with a remainder the remainder must be smaller than the divisor—and 0 can never be a divisor.

plot.title: 乘法是「几个几相加」：x 个 3 相加就是 y = 3x，如 x=4 时 y=12

nodes.title: 四则运算与运算顺序
nodes.titleEn: The Four Operations and Order of Operations
nodes.summary: 加、减、乘、除合称四则运算；先乘除后加减，有括号先算括号里面的（先小括号、再中括号），同级运算从左到右。
nodes.summaryEn: Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division are the four operations; work out multiplication and division before addition and subtraction, do what is inside brackets first, and go left to right for operations of the same rank.

nodes.title: 运算定律与简便计算
nodes.titleEn: Laws of Operation and Mental Math
nodes.summary: 加法交换律、结合律，乘法交换律、结合律、分配律，以及减法、除法的性质，能让计算又快又对；特别注意只有乘法对加法有分配律。
nodes.summaryEn: The commutative and associative laws, the distributive law, and the properties of subtraction and division let us compute quickly and correctly—and only multiplication distributes over addition.

nodes.title: 大数与近似数
nodes.summary: 认识大数：数位顺序表（个级、万级、亿级）、改写成用「万」「亿」作单位的数，还有省略尾数求近似数——改写用「＝」，省略用「≈」。
nodes.summaryEn: Meet large numbers: the place-value table (ones, ten-thousands and hundred-millions groups), rewriting a number in units of 万 or 亿, and rounding a tail off to get an approximate number—rewriting uses '=', rounding uses '≈'.

nodes.title: 四舍五入与近似数
nodes.summary: 四舍五入法只有两步：看准要保留的数位，再看被省略部分的最高位——满 5 进一，不满 5 舍去。
nodes.summaryEn: Rounding has just two steps: decide the place to keep, then look at the highest digit of the part being dropped—5 or more rounds up, less than 5 is cut off.

plot.title: 四舍五入到个位：3.7 在 3.5 的右边，满 5 进一，所以 3.7 ≈ 4

nodes.title: 小数的意义与运算
nodes.summary: 把单位「1」平均分成 10 份、100 份、1000 份……其中的一份或几份就是小数；再学小数点的移动规律和小数四则运算。
nodes.summaryEn: A decimal names one or several parts obtained by splitting the unit 1 into 10, 100 or 1000 equal parts; then come the movement of the decimal point and the four operations.

plot.title: 0 到 1 平均分成 10 份：0.3 在第 3 份处，0.7 在第 7 份处

nodes.title: 分数的意义与运算
nodes.summary: 把单位「1」平均分成若干份，表示其中一份或几份的数叫分数；再学分数单位、约分通分和分数的四则运算。
nodes.summaryEn: Split the unit 1 into equal parts and a fraction names one or several of them; then come fraction units, reducing, common denominators and the four operations on fractions.

plot.title: 面积模型：把单位「1」平均分成 5 份，涂色 2 份就是 2/5

nodes.title: 因数、倍数与质数
nodes.summary: 在非零自然数里研究因数与倍数、2 和 3 和 5 的倍数特征、奇数与偶数、质数与合数，以及最大公因数和最小公倍数。
nodes.summaryEn: Inside the non-zero natural numbers we study factors and multiples, the digit tests for 2, 3 and 5, odd and even numbers, primes and composites, and the greatest common factor with the least common multiple.

plot.title: 2 的倍数（蓝）与 3 的倍数（粉）的重叠处（黄）是公倍数，最小的是 6

nodes.title: 用字母表示数与简易方程
nodes.titleEn: Using Letters for Numbers and Simple Equations
nodes.summary: 用字母表示数（$a^2$ 表示 $a \times a$，不是 $2a$！），认识方程与等式的性质，学会解方程、检验并列出方程解应用题。
nodes.summaryEn: Letters can stand for numbers ($a^2$ means $a \times a$, not $2a$!), and from equations and the properties of equality we learn to solve, check and set up simple equations for word problems.

plot.title: y = 2x 与 y = x + 3 交于点 (3, 6)

nodes.title: 极限
nodes.summary: 描述当自变量趋近某点或趋于无穷时，函数值所趋近的确定常数。
nodes.summaryEn: The value a function approaches as its input approaches a point or grows without bound.

functions.label: y = sin x / x（x→0 时趋近 1）

plot.title: 函数极限的直观：x→0 时 sin x / x→1，x→1 时 (x²−1)/(x−1)→2

nodes.title: 数列极限
nodes.summary: 当项数 n 无限增大时，数列的项所无限接近的那个常数。
nodes.summaryEn: The constant that the terms of a sequence approach as the index n grows without bound.

plot.title: 数列极限的直观（用连续曲线示意）：1/n→0，1+1/n→1

nodes.title: 极限的运算法则
nodes.summary: 在极限都存在且有限的前提下，求极限与四则运算可以交换次序。
nodes.summaryEn: Limits commute with arithmetic operations, provided all the limits involved exist and are finite.

nodes.title: 两个重要极限
nodes.summary: sin x / x→1（x→0）与 (1+1/x)^x→e（x→∞），微积分中最常用的两个极限。
nodes.summaryEn: The two most used limits in calculus: sin x / x → 1 as x → 0, and (1 + 1/x)^x → e as x → ∞.

functions.label: y = sin x / x（x→0 时趋近 1）

plot.title: 两个重要极限：sin x / x→1，(1+x)^(1/x)→e（x→0）

nodes.title: 无穷小与无穷大
nodes.summary: 极限为 0 的变量是无穷小，绝对值无限增大的变量是无穷大，二者互为倒数。
nodes.summaryEn: A quantity tending to 0 is an infinitesimal; one whose size grows without bound is infinite; the two are reciprocals.

plot.title: x→0 时 x、x²、x³ 趋于 0 的快慢：阶数越高，贴近 0 越快

nodes.title: 函数的连续性
nodes.summary: 函数在一点的极限等于该点的函数值，图像是一条没有断裂的曲线。
nodes.summaryEn: A function is continuous where its limit equals its value, so its graph has no breaks.

plot.title: 连续函数的图像：一条连绵不断、没有断裂的曲线

nodes.title: 间断点及其分类
nodes.summary: 不连续的点叫间断点，按左右极限分为第一类（可去、跳跃）与第二类（无穷、振荡）。
nodes.summaryEn: Points of discontinuity are classified by their one-sided limits: removable or jump (type I), infinite or oscillatory (type II).

plot.title: 可去间断点：y = (x²−1)/(x−1) 在 x=1 处无定义，补上 (1, 2) 即连续

nodes.title: 闭区间上连续函数的性质
nodes.titleEn: Properties of Continuous Functions on a Closed Interval
nodes.summary: 闭区间上的连续函数必有界、有最值，并能取到最小值与最大值之间的一切值。
nodes.summaryEn: A continuous function on a closed interval is bounded, attains its extrema, and takes every value in between.

plot.title: 介值定理（零点定理）：f(0)=1>0，f(1)=−1<0，曲线在 (0,1) 内必然穿过 y=0

nodes.title: 负数的初步认识
nodes.summary: 比 0 小的数叫做负数。气温零下、海拔低于海平面、支出比收入多，都可以用负数表示；0 既不是正数也不是负数。
nodes.summaryEn: Numbers smaller than 0 are called negative numbers; temperatures below zero, heights below sea level and spending more than you earn can all be written with them, while 0 is neither positive nor negative.

plot.title: 数轴：负数在 0 左边，右边的数总比左边的大（-1 > -3）

nodes.title: 比与比例
nodes.summary: 两个数相除又叫做两个数的比；表示两个比相等的式子叫比例。这里还有正比例、反比例和比例尺。
nodes.summaryEn: Dividing one number by another gives their ratio, and a proportion says that two ratios are equal — together with direct and inverse proportion and scale drawings.

plot.title: 正比例 y=2x 与反比例 y=12/x（商一定与积一定）

nodes.title: 百分数
nodes.summary: 表示一个数是另一个数的百分之几的数叫百分数，也叫百分率或百分比；它只表示倍比关系，不能带单位名称。
nodes.summaryEn: A percentage states how many hundredths one number is of another; it expresses only a relative comparison and never carries a unit.

nodes.title: 长度单位
nodes.summary: 千米、米、分米、厘米、毫米——量长度要挑合适的单位，换算时记住每个进率。
nodes.summaryEn: Kilometres, metres, decimetres, centimetres and millimetres — choose a sensible unit for each length and convert using fixed rates.

plot.title: 1 米 = 10 分米 = 100 厘米 = 1000 毫米（每小段 1 分米）

nodes.title: 面积与体积单位
nodes.summary: 面积单位之间的进率是 100，体积单位之间的进率是 1000；升和毫升是容积单位，1 升 = 1 立方分米。
nodes.summaryEn: Neighbouring area units step by 100 and volume units by 1000, while the litre and millilitre measure capacity, with 1 L = 1 dm³.

elements.text: 每小格 = 1 平方厘米，共 100 格

plot.title: 1 平方分米 = 100 平方厘米（分成 10 × 10 个小格）

nodes.title: 质量与时间单位
nodes.summary: 吨、千克、克量质量，时、分、秒量时间；年月日里还藏着大月、小月和闰年的规律。
nodes.summaryEn: Tonnes, kilograms and grams measure mass, while hours, minutes and seconds measure time — and the calendar hides the rules of big months, small months and leap years.

nodes.title: 认识立体图形
nodes.summary: 认识长方体、正方体、圆柱和球，数清它们的面、棱和顶点。
nodes.summaryEn: Get to know the cuboid, cube, cylinder and sphere, and count their faces, edges and vertices.

plot.title: 长方体与圆柱

nodes.title: 角的初步认识与度量
nodes.summary: 从一点引出两条射线组成角；用度来量角，分清锐角、直角、钝角、平角和周角。
nodes.summaryEn: Two rays from one point form an angle; measure it in degrees and tell acute, right, obtuse, straight and full angles apart.

elements.text: 角的大小与边画多长无关

plot.title: 锐角、直角和钝角

nodes.title: 周长
nodes.summary: 封闭图形一周的长度叫周长；长方形周长 =（长 + 宽）× 2，正方形周长 = 边长 × 4。
nodes.summaryEn: The perimeter is the distance all the way round a closed figure: (length + width) × 2 for a rectangle and side × 4 for a square.

plot.title: 长方形与正方形（标出边长）

nodes.title: 面积与面积公式
nodes.summary: 面积是物体表面或封闭图形的大小；掌握长方形、正方形、平行四边形、三角形和梯形的面积公式。
nodes.summaryEn: Area measures the size of a surface; learn the formulas for rectangles, squares, parallelograms, triangles and trapezoids.

elements.text: 平行四边形：面积 = 底 × 高
三角形：面积 = 底 × 高 ÷ 2

plot.title: 平行四边形与三角形（标出底和高）

nodes.title: 圆的周长与面积
nodes.titleEn: Circumference and Area of a Circle
nodes.summary: 认识圆心、半径、直径和圆周率；圆的周长 C = πd = 2πr，面积 S = πr²。
nodes.summaryEn: Meet the centre, radius, diameter and π; the circumference is C = πd = 2πr and the area is S = πr².

plot.title: 圆心、半径与直径

nodes.title: 立体图形的体积
nodes.summary: 物体占空间的大小叫体积；掌握长方体、正方体、圆柱、圆锥的体积公式和表面积公式。
nodes.summaryEn: Volume is how much space a solid occupies; learn the volume and surface-area formulas for cuboids, cubes, cylinders and cones.

elements.text: 等底等高：圆锥 = 1/3 圆柱

plot.title: 长方体、圆柱与圆锥

nodes.title: 图形的运动
nodes.summary: 平移、旋转和轴对称，是图形在平面里「动起来」的三种方式：位置变了，形状和大小不变。
nodes.summaryEn: Translation, rotation and axial symmetry are the three ways a figure moves in the plane: its position changes, while its shape and size stay the same.

plot.title: 平移：只改变位置，形状和大小不变

nodes.title: 观察物体
nodes.summary: 从前面、上面、左面等不同方向观察同一个物体，看到的形状可能不同；只看一个方向，还不能确定物体是什么样。
nodes.summaryEn: Looking at one object from the front, from above and from the left may give different shapes, and a single view cannot yet determine the object.

elements.text: 同一个长方体，从不同方向看到的形状可能不同

plot.title: 从三个方向观察同一个长方体

nodes.title: 统计图表
nodes.summary: 条形统计图看多少，折线统计图看变化，扇形统计图看关系——三种统计图各有各的本领。
nodes.summaryEn: Bar charts show amounts, line charts show change, and pie charts show parts of a whole—each chart has its own job.

plot.title: 折线统计图：一周气温的增减变化

nodes.title: 平均数
nodes.summary: 平均数 = 总数量 ÷ 总份数；它代表一组数据的整体水平，但特别大或特别小的数会影响它。
nodes.summaryEn: The average equals the total amount divided by the number of items; it stands for the overall level of a data set, though extreme values can affect it.

plot.title: 一组数据 3、4、8、9 与它们的平均数 6

nodes.title: 可能性
nodes.summary: 事情的发生有三种情况：一定、可能、不可能；数量越多，可能性越大，用分数还能把可能性的大小说清楚。
nodes.summaryEn: Events are certain, possible or impossible; more items mean a greater chance, and fractions can describe how likely something is.

nodes.title: 鸡兔同笼
nodes.summary: 鸡兔同笼问题：用「假设—比较—调整」的假设法，算出笼子里鸡和兔各有几只。
nodes.summaryEn: The classic chicken-and-rabbit problem, solved by the 'assume, compare, adjust' method.

nodes.title: 拓扑空间
nodes.summary: 在集合上指定一族满足「含空集与全集、任意并、有限交」的开集，就得到拓扑空间：连续性、收敛、紧致与连通自此只依赖这一族集合。
nodes.summaryEn: A set together with a family of open sets closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections — the arena in which continuity, convergence, compactness and connectedness live.

nodes.title: 基与子基
nodes.summary: 基是「用更少的集合生成全部开集」的工具：每个开集都是基元的并；子基更进一步，取有限交即得基。判定基的两条条件缺一不可。
nodes.summaryEn: A basis generates every open set from a smaller family of unions; a subbasis is one step smaller still, its finite intersections forming a basis. Both basis conditions are indispensable.

nodes.title: 闭集、闭包与内部
nodes.summary: 闭集就是补集为开集的集合，闭集族满足「任意交、有限并」；闭包是含 A 的最小闭集，内部是含于 A 的最大开集，边界把它们分开。
nodes.summaryEn: Closed sets are the complements of open sets and satisfy arbitrary intersections and finite unions; the closure is the smallest closed set containing A, the interior the largest open set inside it, and the boundary separates them.

plot.title: A = (0,1)（蓝）与它的闭包 cl A = [0,1]：端点 0、1 不属于 A

nodes.title: 连续映射与同胚
nodes.summary: 连续即「开集的原像是开集」，把连续双射且逆也连续的双射叫同胚；同胚是拓扑学的「相同」，被它保持的性质叫拓扑性质。
nodes.summaryEn: Continuity means preimages of open sets are open; a bijection whose inverse is also continuous is a homeomorphism, the topological notion of sameness, and properties preserved by it are topological.

plot.title: 圆与正方形边界同胚：径向投影给出连续双射，且逆映射连续

nodes.title: 子空间、积空间与商空间
nodes.summary: 从旧空间造新空间的三大手术：子空间取相对开集、积空间取「最粗」使投影连续的拓扑、商空间取「最细」使商映射连续的拓扑。
nodes.summaryEn: Three ways to build new spaces: relative open sets for subspaces, the coarsest topology making projections continuous for products, the finest making the quotient map continuous for quotients.

nodes.title: 分离公理（T₀–T₄）
nodes.summary: 用开集能多精细地分离点与闭集，把拓扑空间分层：T₀、T₁、T₂（Hausdorff）、T₃（正则）、T₄（正规），蕴含方向 T₄⇒T₃⇒T₂⇒T₁⇒T₀ 不可逆。
nodes.summaryEn: How finely open sets separate points and closed sets stratifies spaces: T₀, T₁, T₂ (Hausdorff), T₃ (regular), T₄ (normal), with the irreversible chain T₄⇒T₃⇒T₂⇒T₁⇒T₀.

nodes.title: 紧致性
nodes.summary: 任意开覆盖都能挑出有限子覆盖——这条条件把闭区间上「有界、取到最值」的种种好处提炼成一个可以搬到任意拓扑空间的性质。
nodes.summaryEn: Every open cover has a finite subcover — one condition that captures the good behaviour of a closed interval and travels to any topological space.

plot.title: [0,1] 紧：端点在区间内；(0,1) 不紧：端点被挖去——差别就在两个端点上

nodes.title: 度量空间中的紧致性
nodes.summary: 在度量空间里紧性等价于列紧、也等价于完备加全有界；Heine–Borel 定理、勒贝格数引理与一致连续性都是这套刻画的自然产物。
nodes.summaryEn: In metric spaces compactness equals sequential compactness equals completeness plus total boundedness; Heine–Borel, the Lebesgue number lemma and uniform continuity all follow.

nodes.title: 连通性与道路连通性
nodes.summary: 「一整块、没被切开」的拓扑表述：不能写成两个非空不交开集之并；道路连通更强，但两者之间有著名的拓扑学家的正弦曲线。
nodes.summaryEn: The topological meaning of 「one piece」: the space cannot be split into two disjoint nonempty open sets. Path connectedness is stronger, and the topologist's sine curve separates the two notions.

plot.title: y = 1/x 的图形分成互不相连的两支：y 轴（x = 0）把它们隔开，整体不连通

nodes.title: 可数性公理与可分性
nodes.summary: 第一可数、第二可数、可分、Lindelöf：衡量空间「有多小」的四个刻度；在度量空间里 C₁ 自动成立，其余三条（C₂、可分、Lindelöf）塌缩为同一个条件。
nodes.summaryEn: First countable, second countable, separable, Lindelöf — four measures of how small a space is; in metric spaces C₁ is automatic and the other three coincide.

nodes.title: 吉洪诺夫定理
nodes.summary: 任意多个紧空间之积（配积拓扑）仍然紧；这里的「任意」不仅包含无限，还与选择公理等价。
nodes.summaryEn: An arbitrary product of compact spaces is compact in the product topology; the 「arbitrary」 is essential, and the theorem is equivalent to the axiom of choice.

nodes.title: 局部紧性与紧化
nodes.summary: 每点都有紧邻域的空间可以补上一个无穷远点变成紧空间——实直线加一点就是圆周，Rⁿ 加一点就是球面。
nodes.summaryEn: A space in which every point has a compact neighbourhood can be made compact by adjoining a single point at infinity: the line plus one point is a circle, Rⁿ plus one point is a sphere.

plot.title: 实直线加一个无穷远点：−∞ 与 +∞ 粘成同一点 ∞，于是 ℝ ∪ {∞} 同胚于圆周 S¹

nodes.title: 同伦与同伦等价
nodes.summary: 同伦是「连续形变」的严格说法：两个连续映射能由一族连续映射彼此过渡就叫同伦；由此得到的同伦等价比同胚更宽松，却恰好是基本群、同调群这类代数不变量所尊重的等价关系。
nodes.summaryEn: Homotopy is the rigorous form of “continuous deformation”: two continuous maps are homotopic if a continuous family of maps joins them. The resulting homotopy equivalence is coarser than homeomorphism, yet it is exactly the relation respected by algebraic invariants such as the fundamental group.

elements.text: 端点 P、Q 全程不动（rel {0,1}）

plot.title: 同伦：H(·,t) 把曲线 f 连续形变成 g（同一族曲线）

nodes.title: 基本群
nodes.summary: 以 $x_0$ 为基点的闭路按「相对端点同伦」分类、以道路衔接为乘法构成的群 $\pi_1(X,x_0)$；它把空间的形状翻译成代数，而且是同伦不变量。
nodes.summaryEn: The group $\pi_1(X,x_0)$ of loops based at $x_0$ modulo homotopy relative to the endpoints, with concatenation of paths as the operation. It translates shape into algebra and is a homotopy invariant.

plot.title: 基本群：以 x₀ 为基点的闭路按相对端点同伦分类

nodes.title: 圆周的基本群
nodes.titleEn: The Fundamental Group of the Circle
nodes.summary: $\pi_1(S^1,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}$：闭路的同伦类由「绕几圈」这个整数完全决定。这是代数拓扑的第一个非平凡定理，证明靠覆叠空间 $\mathbb{R}\to S^1$ 的提升性质。
nodes.summaryEn: $\pi_1(S^1,x_0)\cong\mathbb{Z}$: the homotopy class of a loop is completely determined by an integer, its winding number. This is the first non-trivial theorem of algebraic topology, proved with the lifting properties of the covering $\mathbb{R}\to S^1$.

elements.text: 闭路沿箭头绕 3 圈后再回到 x₀
圈数 = 3（提升 θ 从 0 走到 6π）

plot.title: 绕 n 圈对应整数 n：π₁(S¹) 是整数加群（图中绕 3 圈）

nodes.title: 覆叠空间
nodes.summary: 局部同胚、整体多对一的空间 $p:E\to B$：每点在底空间上有被均匀覆叠的邻域。它的道路提升与同伦提升性质把基本群的计算变成「展开成直线」的问题。
nodes.summaryEn: A locally homeomorphic, globally many-to-one map $p:E\to B$: every point of the base has an evenly covered neighbourhood. Its path-lifting and homotopy-lifting properties reduce questions about $\pi_1$ to unrolling the base onto a line.

elements.text: t 与 t+1 映到同一点

plot.title: 覆叠映射 exp(2πit)：数轴覆叠圆周（每点有无穷多原像）

nodes.title: 塞弗特–范坎彭定理
nodes.summary: 把空间拆成两个开集 $U,V$，则 $\pi_1(U\cup V)$ 由 $\pi_1(U)$、$\pi_1(V)$ 沿 $\pi_1(U\cap V)$ 并合而成；交单连通时就是自由积。这是计算基本群最有力的工具。
nodes.summaryEn: Split a space into open sets $U$ and $V$: then $\pi_1(U\cup V)$ is built from $\pi_1(U)$ and $\pi_1(V)$ amalgamated over $\pi_1(U\cap V)$; when the intersection is simply connected this is just the free product. The strongest tool for computing fundamental groups.

elements.text: X = U ∪ V：三块都道路连通，基点取在交中

plot.title: 范坎彭定理：π₁(X) 由 π₁(U) 与 π₁(V) 沿交并合而成

nodes.title: 布劳威尔不动点定理
nodes.summary: 闭球上任何连续自映射都有不动点；等价说法是「$S^{n-1}$ 不是 $\overline{B^n}$ 的收缩核」。一维用中值定理，高维必须用代数拓扑（$\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})\cong\mathbb{Z}$）。
nodes.summaryEn: Every continuous self-map of a closed ball has a fixed point; equivalently $S^{n-1}$ is not a retract of $\overline{B^n}$. The case $n=1$ follows from the intermediate value theorem; higher dimensions require algebraic topology ($\pi_{n-1}(S^{n-1})\cong\mathbb{Z}$).

plot.title: y = cos x 与 y = x 的交点即不动点（虚线为该点切线）

nodes.title: 单纯复形与三角剖分
nodes.summary: 由点、线段、三角形、四面体这些标准积木按两条严格规则粘成的有限组合结构；它把连续空间的拓扑问题翻译成有限组合计算，是单纯同调与组合拓扑的入口。
nodes.summaryEn: A finite combinatorial structure glued from standard blocks — points, segments, triangles, tetrahedra — under two strict rules; it translates continuous topology into finite combinatorial computation and is the doorway to simplicial homology.

plot.title: 把方块曲面剖分成 4 个三角形（面封闭 + 交条件都满足）

nodes.title: 单纯同调群
nodes.summary: 把各维单形组织成链群、用边界算子 $\partial$ 串成链复形；由 $\partial\circ\partial=0$ 得 $B_n\subseteq Z_n$，从而定义 $H_n=Z_n/B_n$——一套纯组合、解线性方程组就能算出的拓扑不变量。
nodes.summaryEn: Organize simplices into chain groups and chain them into a chain complex via the boundary operator; since ∂∘∂ = 0 we have Bₙ ⊆ Zₙ and may set Hₙ = Zₙ/Bₙ — a purely combinatorial topological invariant computable by linear algebra.

plot.title: 三角形边界是一个 1-闭链：∂([a,b]+[b,c]+[c,a]) = 0

nodes.title: 同调群
nodes.summary: 给每个空间配上「第 $n$ 维洞」的代数测量：$H_0$ 数连通分支、$H_1$ 数一维的环、$H_2$ 数二维空腔；它是同伦不变量，也是 $\pi_1$ 的阿贝尔化（对道路连通空间），比同伦群好算得多。
nodes.summaryEn: An algebraic measurement of the $n$-dimensional holes of a space: $H_0$ counts path components, $H_1$ counts one-dimensional loops, $H_2$ counts two-dimensional cavities; it is a homotopy invariant, the abelianization of $\pi_1$, and far easier to compute than homotopy groups.

nodes.title: 欧拉示性数
nodes.summary: 把各维单形个数带交错符号相加得到的数 $\chi=V-E+F-\cdots$：它是同伦不变量，等于 Betti 数的交错和，并且是闭曲面分类的数值标尺（$\chi(S^2)=2$、$\chi(T^2)=0$、$\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1$）。
nodes.summaryEn: The alternating sum of the numbers of simplices, $\chi=V-E+F-\cdots$: a homotopy invariant equal to the alternating sum of Betti numbers, and the numerical ruler of surface classification ($\chi(S^2)=2$, $\chi(T^2)=0$, $\chi(\mathrm{RP}^2)=1$).

plot.title: 四面体表面：4 个顶点、6 条棱、4 个三角形面，χ = 2（球面）

nodes.title: 曲面的分类
nodes.summary: 闭曲面的同胚类只有三种：球面、$n$ 个环面的连通和、$m$ 个射影平面的连通和；判定两张闭曲面是否同胚，只需比较可定向性与欧拉示性数。
nodes.summaryEn: Closed surfaces fall into exactly three homeomorphism types: the sphere, connected sums of $n$ tori, and connected sums of $m$ projective planes; two closed surfaces are homeomorphic iff they share orientability and Euler characteristic.

elements.text: 连通和让亏格相加，球面是「零元」

plot.title: 分类定理的两类标准形：球面 S² 与环面 T²（均可定向）

nodes.title: 德拉姆上同调
nodes.summary: 用微分形式定义的上同调 $H^n_{dR}(M)=\{\text{闭 }n\text{-形式}\}/\{\text{恰当 }n\text{-形式}\}$：由 $d^2=0$ 保证定义合法，德拉姆定理又断言它与奇异上同调 $H^n(M;\mathbb R)$ 同构——拓扑量可以用分析手段算出来。
nodes.summaryEn: Cohomology defined by differential forms, $H^n_{dR}(M)=\{\text{closed }n\text{-forms}\}/\{\text{exact }n\text{-forms}\}$: valid because $d^2=0$, and by de Rham's theorem isomorphic to singular cohomology $H^n(M;\mathbb R)$ — analysis computing topology.

nodes.title: 共形映射
nodes.summary: 共形映射是在一点既保角又保持定向的映射；解析函数恰好在其导数非零处局部共形，「导数非零」是这条几何性质的门槛。
nodes.summaryEn: A conformal mapping preserves both the size and the orientation of angles at a point; an analytic function is locally conformal exactly at points where its derivative is nonzero.

plot.title: w = z²：网格在 z ≠ 0 处保持正交（共形），原点处夹角被放大 2 倍

nodes.title: 分式线性变换
nodes.summary: 分式线性变换 w=(az+b)/(cz+d)（ad−bc≠0）是扩充复平面到自身的一一变换，把圆与直线统一地映为圆或直线，并由三点唯一确定。
nodes.summaryEn: A Möbius transformation w=(az+b)/(cz+d) with ad−bc≠0 is a one-to-one map of the extended complex plane onto itself that sends circles and lines to circles and lines and is determined by three points.

plot.title: w = 1/z：网格线（取样避开原点）映为过原点的圆或直线（保圆性的直接图像）

nodes.title: 黎曼映射定理
nodes.summary: 任何单连通真子区域都能共形地一一映到单位圆盘，且固定一点与一个方向后映射唯一；「D ≠ ℂ」这个条件不可去掉。
nodes.summaryEn: Every simply connected proper subregion can be mapped conformally and bijectively onto the unit disk, uniquely once a point and a direction are fixed; the condition D ≠ ℂ cannot be dropped.

plot.title: w = i(1−z)/(1+z)：单位圆映为实轴，单位圆盘映为上半平面

nodes.title: 施瓦茨引理
nodes.summary: 单位圆盘上解析、f(0)=0 且 |f|≤1 的函数满足 |f(z)|≤|z| 与 |f′(0)|≤1；等号成立当且仅当 f 是旋转。
nodes.summaryEn: For an analytic f on the unit disk with f(0)=0 and |f|≤1 one has |f(z)|≤|z| and |f′(0)|≤1, with equality if and only if f is a rotation.

plot.title: w = z²：正方形网格（整块落在单位圆盘内）的像仍在半径更小的圆盘内，|w| = |z|² ≤ |z|

nodes.title: 最大模原理
nodes.summary: 在区域内部解析的非常数函数，其模在内部取不到最大值——最大值只能在边界上；由此得最小模原理与最大实部原理。
nodes.summaryEn: A nonconstant function analytic on a region cannot attain its maximum modulus in the interior — the maximum lies on the boundary; this yields the minimum modulus and maximum real part principles.

plot.title: |f(z)| = |z|²（f(z) = z²）的等值线：最大值只能在区域边界上取到

nodes.title: 解析延拓
nodes.summary: 解析延拓是沿曲线用幂级数接力地把解析函数延拓出去的唯一过程；唯一性由同一性定理保证，障碍是自然边界，多值性则要用黎曼面描述。
nodes.summaryEn: Analytic continuation extends an analytic function step by step along curves by re-expanding power series; uniqueness is guaranteed by the identity theorem, obstructions are natural boundaries, and multivaluedness requires Riemann surfaces.

nodes.title: 单值性定理
nodes.summary: 在单连通区域内，若一个解析函数芽能沿区域内每一条曲线延拓，则延拓结果只依赖终点，从而在区域上确定一个单值解析函数。
nodes.summaryEn: In a simply connected domain, if an analytic germ can be continued along every curve, the result depends only on the endpoint and therefore defines a single-valued analytic function.

nodes.title: 整函数
nodes.summary: 在整个复平面 $\mathbb{C}$ 上处处解析的函数，等价于一个收敛半径为无穷的幂级数；按最大模的增长阶 $\rho$ 可分类，多项式阶为 0，$e^z$、$\sin z$ 阶为 1。
nodes.summaryEn: A function analytic on the whole complex plane, equivalently a power series with infinite radius of convergence; classified by the order of growth $\rho$ of its maximum modulus, with polynomials of order 0 and $e^z$, $\sin z$ of order 1.

nodes.title: 魏尔斯特拉斯分解定理
nodes.summary: 以任给的无聚点零点列（配重数）构造整函数的无穷乘积定理，因子为初等因子 $E_n(z)=(1-z)e^{z+z^2/2+\cdots+z^n/n}$；经典例子是 $\frac{\sin\pi z}{\pi z}=\prod_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(1-\frac{z^2}{n^2}\right)$。
nodes.summaryEn: The infinite-product theorem constructing an entire function with any prescribed zero set having no accumulation point, using the elementary factors $E_n(z)=(1-z)e^{z+z^2/2+\cdots+z^n/n}$; the classical example is $\sin(\pi z)/(\pi z)=\prod_{n=1}^{\infty}(1-z^2/n^2)$.

plot.title: sin(πx)/(πx) 及其部分乘积：零点相同的无穷乘积逼近

nodes.title: 亚纯函数
nodes.summary: 区域 $D$ 内除极点外处处解析的函数（奇点只能是极点）；等价于两个解析函数之商，而扩充复平面上的亚纯函数恰是有理函数。
nodes.summaryEn: A function analytic on a domain except at poles (the only possible singularities); equivalently a quotient of two analytic functions, while the meromorphic functions on the Riemann sphere are exactly the rational functions.

plot.title: 亚纯函数 (z³−1)/(z²+1)：零点为三个立方根、极点为 ±i（都在单位圆上）

nodes.title: 米塔-列夫勒定理
nodes.summary: 给定无聚点的极点列与各点的主部，存在以它们为极点且主部恰如所设的亚纯函数，解唯一到相差一个整函数；与魏尔斯特拉斯（管零点）互为对偶。
nodes.summaryEn: Given poles without accumulation point and prescribed principal parts, there exists a meromorphic function with exactly those poles and principal parts, unique up to an entire function; it is dual to the Weierstrass theorem on zeros.

nodes.title: 皮卡定理
nodes.summary: 小定理：非常数整函数取到每个复数值，至多一个例外；大定理：本性奇点的去心邻域内，函数取到每个值无穷多次，至多一个例外。它蕴含刘维尔定理与魏尔斯特拉斯定理。
nodes.summaryEn: Little theorem: a non-constant entire function assumes every complex value with at most one exception. Great theorem: near an essential singularity every value is assumed infinitely often, with at most one exception. Together they imply Liouville's and Weierstrass's theorems.

plot.title: y = eˣ 恒正：它取到一切正数，唯独取不到 0（皮卡例外值）

nodes.title: 正规族与蒙泰尔定理
nodes.summary: 正规族是「任意序列都能抽出内闭一致收敛子列」的解析函数族；蒙泰尔定理证明了只要在紧子集上一致有界就已正规，这是黎曼映射定理与皮卡定理证明的核心工具。
nodes.summaryEn: A normal family is one in which every sequence of holomorphic functions has a subsequence converging uniformly on compact subsets; Montel's theorem shows that local uniform boundedness alone suffices.

nodes.title: 伽马函数
nodes.summary: 伽马函数 $\Gamma(z)=\int_0^\infty t^{z-1}e^{-t}dt$ 是阶乘在复数域上的解析推广，它满足函数方程 $\Gamma(z+1)=z\Gamma(z)$、反射公式 $\Gamma(z)\Gamma(1-z)=\pi/\sin\pi z$，在 $z=0,-1,-2,\dots$ 处有一阶极点。
nodes.summaryEn: The gamma function Γ(z) = ∫₀^∞ t^{z−1}e^{−t} dt is the analytic extension of the factorial; it satisfies Γ(z+1) = zΓ(z) and the reflection formula Γ(z)Γ(1−z) = π/sin(πz), with simple poles at z = 0, −1, −2, …

nodes.title: 黎曼 ζ 函数
nodes.summary: ζ(s)=Σ n^(−s) 在 Re s>1 由 Dirichlet 级数定义，欧拉乘积把它与素数相连；解析延拓后它在整个平面上只有一个简单极点 s=1（留数 1），其非平凡零点的位置就是黎曼猜想（尚未证明）。
nodes.summaryEn: ζ(s) = Σ n^{−s} converges for Re s > 1 and its Euler product links it to the primes; after analytic continuation it has a single simple pole at s = 1 (residue 1), and the location of its nontrivial zeros is the Riemann Hypothesis (still unproved).

plot.title: ζ(s) 在实轴 s > 1 上的部分和（收敛到 1，且在 s=2 处逼近 π²/6）

nodes.title: 椭圆函数
nodes.summary: 椭圆函数是定义在复平面上、具有两个不可公度周期的亚纯函数；由刘维尔的论证它必须有极点，最典型的例子是魏尔斯特拉斯 ℘ 函数，满足 (℘')² = 4℘³ − g₂℘ − g₃。
nodes.summaryEn: Elliptic functions are meromorphic functions on ℂ with two independent periods; by Liouville's argument they must have poles, the prototype being the Weierstrass ℘ function with (℘')² = 4℘³ − g₂℘ − g₃.

plot.title: 双周期性格子：cos x + cos y 的等值线在 2π 方向上重复排列，正如周期格 Λ 铺满复平面

nodes.title: 施瓦茨–克里斯托费尔变换
nodes.summary: 施瓦茨–克里斯托费尔公式给出把上半平面共形映到多边形内部的显式积分表达式，积分中的幂指数由多边形内角决定，是流体力学与数值保角映射的经典工具。
nodes.summaryEn: The Schwarz–Christoffel formula gives an explicit integral map from the upper half-plane onto the interior of a polygon, with exponents determined by the interior angles — a classical tool in fluid mechanics and numerical conformal mapping.

plot.title: 局部模型 w = √z：上半平面（平角 π）被映成第一象限（直角 π/2）——正是 SC 公式在正方形顶点附近（α_k = 1/2）的行为

nodes.title: 留数技巧进阶
nodes.summary: 针对半圆围道失效的积分——幂次与多值函数的积分、需要取主值的实轴极点积分、以及对衰减条件敏感的有理函数积分——钥匙孔围道、log 技巧、Jordan 引理与小半圆引理提供了标准处理方式。
nodes.summaryEn: For integrals beyond the plain semicircle method — power and multivalued integrands, principal values at real poles, rational integrands with slow decay — the keyhole contour, the log trick, Jordan's lemma and the small-arc lemma are the standard tools.

plot.title: 用留数算 ∫₀^∞ dx/(1+x³)：扇形围道（0<arg z<2π/3）内只有极点 $e^{i\pi/3}$，另两个极点都在围道外，无需主值；只有改算 ∫_{−∞}^{∞} 时才需 PV 处理实轴上的 $z=-1$

nodes.title: 导数
nodes.summary: 函数在某一点的瞬时变化率，几何上等于该点处切线的斜率。
nodes.summaryEn: The instantaneous rate of change of a function at a point, geometrically the slope of the tangent line there.

plot.title: 导数的几何意义：y = x² 在 x = 1 处的切线

nodes.title: 求导法则
nodes.summary: 用基本导数公式与和、差、积、商的运算法则计算函数的导数。
nodes.summaryEn: Computing derivatives with the basic derivative formulas and the sum, product and quotient rules.

plot.title: y = x³ 与它的导数曲线 y′ = 3x²

nodes.title: 链式法则
nodes.summary: 复合函数的导数等于外层函数的导数乘以内层函数的导数。
nodes.summaryEn: The derivative of a composite function is the outer derivative times the inner derivative.

plot.title: y = sin(x²) 及其导数曲线 y′ = 2x·cos(x²)

nodes.title: 高阶导数
nodes.summary: 对导数再求导，得到二阶、三阶乃至 n 阶导数。
nodes.summaryEn: Differentiating a derivative again yields second, third and in general n-th order derivatives.

plot.title: y = x³ 及其一阶、二阶导数

nodes.title: 隐函数求导
nodes.summary: 对方程 F(x,y)=0 两边同时对 x 求导来求 y′ 的方法。
nodes.summaryEn: Finding y′ by differentiating both sides of F(x,y)=0 with respect to x.

plot.title: 圆 x² + y² = 25 在 P(3,4) 处的切线：3x + 4y = 25

nodes.title: 参数方程求导
nodes.summary: 由参数方程确定的函数，用 dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt) 求导。
nodes.summaryEn: For a curve given parametrically, the derivative is dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt).

plot.title: 参数曲线：椭圆 x = 5cos t，y = 3sin t

nodes.title: 微分
nodes.summary: 函数增量的线性主部 dy = f′(x)dx，用于近似计算。
nodes.summaryEn: The linear main part of the increment, dy = f′(x)dx, used for approximations.

plot.title: 微分与线性近似：√x 在 x = 1 附近的切线

nodes.title: 微分中值定理
nodes.summary: 罗尔、拉格朗日与柯西中值定理，用导数刻画函数的整体变化。
nodes.summaryEn: Rolle's, Lagrange's and Cauchy's theorems, linking overall change to the derivative.

plot.title: 拉格朗日中值定理：切线平行于割线

nodes.title: 曲率
nodes.summary: 描述曲线弯曲程度的量：K = |y″| / (1+y′²)^{3/2}。
nodes.summaryEn: Measuring how sharply a curve bends: K = |y″| / (1+y′²)^{3/2}.

plot.title: 抛物线 y = x² 顶点处的密切圆（K = 2，ρ = 1/2）

nodes.title: 调和函数与狄利克雷问题
nodes.titleEn: Harmonic Functions and the Dirichlet Problem
nodes.summary: 调和函数是满足 $\Delta u=0$ 的 $C^2$ 函数，等价刻画是「在每一点的某个邻域内是解析函数的实部」；给定边界值求内部解就是狄利克雷问题——在单位圆盘上由泊松积分给出唯一解，在一般区域上却未必可解。
nodes.summaryEn: Harmonic functions are the $C^2$ solutions of $\Delta u=0$, characterized locally as real parts of analytic functions. Asking for a harmonic function with prescribed boundary values is the Dirichlet problem: uniquely solvable on the unit disk by the Poisson integral, but not solvable on general domains.

plot.title: 单位圆盘上的调和函数 u = x² − y²：等值线是两族双曲线（含退化线 y = ±x）；边界值 u|∂Δ = cos 2t 唯一决定内部

nodes.title: 泊松积分公式
nodes.summary: 泊松积分公式用泊松核 $P_r(\varphi)=\frac{1-r^{2}}{1-2r\cos\varphi+r^{2}}$ 把单位圆周上的连续边界值「卷积」成圆盘内的调和函数；$P_r$ 是正的好核，$r\to1^{-}$ 时 $u$ 连续地取到边界值，故它正是圆盘上狄利克雷问题的显式解。
nodes.summaryEn: The Poisson integral convolves continuous boundary data on the unit circle with the Poisson kernel $P_r(\varphi)=(1-r^{2})/(1-2r\cos\varphi+r^{2})$ into a harmonic function on the disk; the kernel is positive and becomes an approximate identity as $r\to1^{-}$, so the formula is the explicit solution of the Dirichlet problem on the disk.

plot.title: 泊松核 P_r(θ) = (1−|z|²)/|1−z|² 的等值线：等值线是与边界内切于点 z = 1 的圆族（极限圆），越靠近边界越密——边界值「点状」集中于 z = 1

nodes.title: 哈纳克原理
nodes.summary: 哈纳克不等式给出正调和函数在同心圆盘上的双边控制；哈纳克原理则断言：单调递增的调和函数列只要在**一点**收敛，就必在每个紧子集上一致收敛，且极限仍调和——它是调和函数紧性、Perron 方法与狄利克雷问题存在性证明的引擎。
nodes.summaryEn: Harnack's inequality gives two-sided control of a positive harmonic function on concentric disks; Harnack's principle states that a monotone increasing sequence of harmonic functions converging at a single point converges uniformly on every compact subset to a harmonic function — the engine behind compactness, Perron's method and existence for the Dirichlet problem.

nodes.title: 黎曼曲面
nodes.summary: 黎曼曲面是一维复流形——由图卡覆盖、转换函数全纯的空间，是多值函数「单值化」的舞台；黎曼球面、复环面、$w^{2}=P(z)$ 的代数曲线都是标准例子，代数函数的黎曼面是紧的可定向曲面，其亏格由方程的次数决定。
nodes.summaryEn: A Riemann surface is a one-dimensional complex manifold — charts glued by holomorphic transition functions — and the stage on which multivalued functions become single-valued; the Riemann sphere, complex tori and the curves $w^{2}=P(z)$ are the standard examples, and the Riemann surface of an algebraic function is a compact orientable surface whose genus is governed by the degree of the equation.

plot.title: √z 的黎曼面示意（螺旋面）：绕原点转一圈并不回到原处，而是攀上另一叶——多值函数在合适的曲面上变成单值

nodes.title: 单值化定理
nodes.summary: 单值化定理：每个单连通的黎曼曲面恰共形等价于三种模型之一——黎曼球面 $\hat{\mathbb C}$（椭圆型）、复平面 $\mathbb C$（抛物型）、单位圆盘 $\Delta$（双曲型）；一般的黎曼曲面就是这三种万有覆叠之一除以一个离散群。
nodes.summaryEn: The uniformization theorem: every simply connected Riemann surface is conformally equivalent to exactly one of three models — the Riemann sphere $\hat{\mathbb C}$ (elliptic), the complex plane $\mathbb C$ (parabolic), the unit disk $\Delta$ (hyperbolic); a general Riemann surface is one of these universal covers modulo a discrete group.

nodes.title: 双曲几何与庞加莱模型
nodes.titleEn: Hyperbolic Geometry and the Poincaré Model
nodes.summary: 庞加莱圆盘把双曲平面实现为单位圆盘配上度量 $ds^{2}=\frac{4|dz|^{2}}{(1-|z|^{2})^{2}}$：测地线是与边界正交的圆弧，距离由 $\rho(z,w)=2\operatorname{artanh}\left|\frac{z-w}{1-\bar wz}\right|$ 给出；施瓦茨–皮克引理说明解析自映射是双曲度量的收缩，而等距群正是把圆盘映到圆盘的 Möbius 变换。
nodes.summaryEn: The Poincaré disk realises the hyperbolic plane as the unit disk with the metric $ds^{2}=4|dz|^{2}/(1-|z|^{2})^{2}$: geodesics are circular arcs orthogonal to the boundary, distances are $\rho(z,w)=2\operatorname{artanh}\left|\frac{z-w}{1-\bar wz}\right|$, analytic self-maps are contractions by Schwarz–Pick, and the isometry group is the group of disk-preserving Möbius transformations.

plot.title: 伪球面（曳物线旋转面）：曲率恒为 −1 的双曲几何局部模型；完备的双曲平面无法等距嵌入三维欧氏空间，整体几何要靠庞加莱圆盘

nodes.title: 随机过程
nodes.summary: 给定概率空间与指标集 T，一族按 T 编号的随机变量 {X_t}；固定 t 它是随机变量，固定 ω 得到一条样本轨道。
nodes.summaryEn: Given a probability space and an index set T, a family of random variables indexed by T; fixing t gives a random variable and fixing ω gives a sample path.

plot.title: 随机过程的三条示意性样本轨道（正弦和近似，每条内频率互不成比例；并非真随机轨道）

nodes.title: 有限维分布族与柯尔莫哥洛夫扩张定理
nodes.titleEn: Finite-Dimensional Distributions and the Kolmogorov Extension Theorem
nodes.summary: 任意有限多个时刻的联合分布构成的分布族；它满足相容性（置换不变、投影一致），而柯尔莫哥洛夫扩张定理保证反过来相容的分布族必由某个随机过程实现。
nodes.summaryEn: The family of joint laws of any finite set of times; it must be consistent (permutation-invariant and projection-consistent), and Kolmogorov's extension theorem guarantees that any consistent family is realised by an actual process.

nodes.title: 高斯过程
nodes.summary: 任意有限维联合分布都是多元正态的随机过程；它由均值函数与协方差函数完全决定，且宽平稳与严平稳等价。
nodes.summaryEn: A stochastic process all of whose finite-dimensional distributions are multivariate normal; it is determined by its mean and covariance functions, and weak and strict stationarity coincide for it.

plot.title: 高斯过程示意：均值线 m(t)=0.2 与三条样本轨道（由同一衰减振荡核生成；正弦乘指数衰减近似，非真随机轨道）

nodes.title: 平稳过程与宽平稳
nodes.summary: 严平稳要求有限维联合分布对时间平移不变；宽平稳只要求均值为常数、自协方差只依赖滞后。二阶矩有限的严平稳必宽平稳，反之不然；对高斯过程两者等价。
nodes.summaryEn: Strict stationarity demands that every finite-dimensional law be invariant under time shifts, while weak stationarity only requires a constant mean and an autocovariance depending on the lag alone; finite second moments make strict imply weak, the converse fails, and for Gaussian processes the two coincide.

functions.label: 强相关轨道示意（R(k) 衰减慢）
弱相关轨道示意（R(k) 衰减快）

plot.title: 宽平稳序列示意：均值恒为 μ=1，两条轨道的差别只在相关性强弱（正弦和近似，非真随机轨道）

nodes.title: 白噪声与谱密度
nodes.summary: 白噪声是零均值、同方差、不同时刻不相关的序列，谱密度为常数；宽平稳序列的自协方差经傅里叶变换得到谱密度，一般情形由 Wiener–辛钦定理给出谱测度。
nodes.summaryEn: White noise is a zero-mean, constant-variance sequence whose terms are uncorrelated across time, with a constant spectral density; the spectral density of a weakly stationary sequence is the Fourier transform of its autocovariance, the general case being the Wiener–Khinchin theorem.

plot.title: 谱密度曲线（σ²=1，λ∈[−π,π]）：白噪声是水平常数谱，AR(1) 在 λ=0 有峰低估高频，MA(1) 在 λ=π 取最小

nodes.title: 遍历定理与混合性
nodes.summary: 遍历性就是不可约性（不变集的概率只能是 0 或 1）；Birkhoff 遍历定理说严平稳遍历序列的时间平均几乎必然收敛到空间平均。混合性更强：混合 ⇒ 遍历，反之不成立。
nodes.summaryEn: Ergodicity is irreducibility — invariant sets have probability 0 or 1; Birkhoff's theorem says the time average of a strictly stationary ergodic sequence converges almost surely to the ensemble average. Mixing is stronger: mixing implies ergodic, and not conversely.

functions.label: 示意性样本轨道（正弦和近似）

plot.title: 遍历定理示意：样本轨道（蓝）的累积时间平均（绿）收敛到空间平均 μ=1；轨道为固定正弦和近似（非真随机轨道），累积平均按解析公式绘制

nodes.title: 马尔可夫链
nodes.summary: 马尔可夫链是「未来只依赖现在」的随机过程：给定当前状态，过去与将来条件独立；它的全部一步信息装在一个每行和为 1 的转移矩阵里。
nodes.summaryEn: A Markov chain is a random process whose future depends on the past only through the present; all of its one-step information is stored in a row-stochastic transition matrix.

elements.text: p₁₂ = p₂₃ = p₃₁ = 1/2；另 1/2 原地不动（自环）

plot.title: 三状态马尔可夫链的转移图

nodes.title: 查普曼–柯尔莫哥洛夫方程与转移矩阵
nodes.summary: 多步转移概率由一步转移矩阵的幂给出，其关键是查普曼–柯尔莫哥洛夫方程 $P^{(m+n)} = P^{(m)}P^{(n)}$——按中间时刻所在状态求和。
nodes.summaryEn: Multi-step transition probabilities are powers of the one-step matrix; the reason is the Chapman–Kolmogorov equation $P^{(m+n)}=P^{(m)}P^{(n)}$, which sums over the state at the intermediate time.

plot.title: 两状态链的 n 步转移概率趋于平稳分布

nodes.title: 状态分类与常返性
nodes.summary: 按「能否互相到达」把状态分成互通类；状态若从自身出发必返回（$f_{ii} = 1$）就是常返，否则是瞬态，常返再按平均返回时间有限与否分为正常返与零常返。
nodes.summaryEn: States are grouped into communicating classes; a state is recurrent when it returns to itself with probability one and transient otherwise, and recurrence splits into positive and null according to whether the mean return time is finite.

elements.text: 瞬态类迟早泄漏到闭常返类；闭类内互达

plot.title: 瞬态类泄漏到闭常返类

nodes.title: 平稳分布与极限定理
nodes.summary: 平稳分布 π 满足 π = πP，是分布演化的不动点；不可约且正常返时它们存在且唯一，不可约、非周期、正常返时 n 步转移概率收敛到 π。
nodes.summaryEn: A stationary distribution satisfies π = πP, a fixed point of the law's evolution; it exists and is unique exactly for irreducible positive recurrent chains, and for aperiodic ones the n-step probabilities converge to it.

plot.title: 三状态链（P = ½I + ½C）：μ₀=(1,0,0) 的分布绕 π 振荡收敛到 (1/3,1/3,1/3)

nodes.title: 生灭过程
nodes.summary: 生灭过程只允许相邻状态之间的转移，生率 λₙ 与灭率 μₙ 决定一切；平稳分布由细致平衡递归给出，M/M/1 情形是参数 ρ = λ/μ 的几何分布，且仅当 ρ < 1 存在。
nodes.summaryEn: A birth–death process moves only between neighbouring states; its stationary distribution follows from a one-step detailed-balance recursion, and for M/M/1 it is geometric with ρ = λ/μ, existing iff ρ < 1.

plot.title: M/M/1 的平稳分布：πₙ = (1−ρ)ρⁿ 在整数 n 上的取值（几何分布）

nodes.title: 连续时间马尔可夫链
nodes.summary: 连续时间马尔可夫链用转移速率矩阵 Q（生成元）代替一步转移矩阵：P(t) = e^{tQ}，满足半群方程 P(t+s) = P(t)P(s) 与 Kolmogorov 前进/后退方程，逗留时间服从指数分布。
nodes.summaryEn: A continuous-time Markov chain replaces the one-step matrix by the generator Q, with P(t) = e^{tQ}, the semigroup law P(t+s) = P(t)P(s), the Kolmogorov forward/backward equations, and exponential holding times.

plot.title: 两状态连续时间链（λ=1, μ=2）：转移概率 P(t) 的演化

nodes.title: 泊松过程
nodes.summary: 计数过程 N(t) 的独立平稳增量模型：N(t)~Poisson(λt)，到达间隔独立同分布指数，给定 N(t)=n 时到达时刻是 [0,t] 上均匀分布的次序统计量。
nodes.summaryEn: The counting process with independent stationary increments: N(t)~Poisson(λt), i.i.d. exponential interarrival times, and uniform order statistics conditionally on N(t)=n.

plot.title: 泊松过程轨道（示意，λ=1.2）与均值 ± √(λt)

nodes.title: 布朗运动
nodes.summary: 具有独立增量、增量服从 N(0,t−s)、轨道几乎必然连续的随机过程；等价于协方差为 min(s,t) 的高斯过程，是随机分析的基础。
nodes.summaryEn: The process with independent increments, N(0,t−s) increments and a.s. continuous paths; equivalently the Gaussian process with covariance min(s,t).

plot.title: 布朗运动样本轨道（正弦和近似示意）与 ±√t 尺度

nodes.title: 布朗运动的性质与路径结构
nodes.titleEn: Properties and Path Structure of Brownian Motion
nodes.summary: 轨道连续却处处不可微：二次变差等于 t、一次变差无穷，振荡尺度由重对数律控制，零点集与水平集是测度零的不可数分形集。
nodes.summaryEn: Continuous but nowhere differentiable paths: quadratic variation t, infinite first variation, oscillation governed by the law of the iterated logarithm, and fractal level sets.

nodes.title: 反射原理与首达时分布
nodes.titleEn: The Reflection Principle and First Passage Times
nodes.summary: 把首次到达水平 a 之后的轨道沿 y=a 对称反射，得 P(max W ≥ a) = 2P(W_t ≥ a)；由此首达时 T_a 的密度为 Lévy 密度，E T_a = ∞。
nodes.summaryEn: Reflecting the path after its first hit of level a gives P(max W ≥ a) = 2P(W_t ≥ a), hence the Lévy density of T_a and E T_a = ∞.

plot.title: 首达时分布 P(T_a≤t)=2(1−Φ(a/√t)) 的近似图像

nodes.title: 鞅
nodes.summary: 条件期望等于当前值的适应可积过程：即「公平赌博」。布朗运动、W_t²−t 与指数过程 e^{θW_t−θ²t/2} 都是鞅。
nodes.summaryEn: Adapted integrable processes whose conditional expectation equals the present value — the mathematical model of a fair game.

plot.title: 鞅 / 下鞅 / 上鞅的样本轨道对比（示意）

nodes.title: 停时与可选停时定理
nodes.titleEn: Stopping Times and the Optional Stopping Theorem
nodes.summary: 停时是不偷看未来即可判断「是否已经发生」的随机时刻（{τ ≤ n} ∈ F_n）；在附加条件下可选停时定理给出 E X_τ = E X_0，条件不可省。
nodes.summaryEn: A stopping time can be detected without looking into the future ({τ ≤ n} ∈ F_n); under extra hypotheses the optional stopping theorem gives E X_τ = E X_0, and the hypotheses are essential.

plot.title: 赌徒破产：首达概率与期望停时（下界 −a = −1，b = x）

nodes.title: 杜布分解与杜布不等式
nodes.summary: 下鞅可唯一分解为「鞅 + 递增可预测过程」，杜布最大值不等式则用终值把下鞅的最大值控制在概率与 L^p 两种尺度下。
nodes.summaryEn: Every submartingale splits uniquely into a martingale plus an increasing predictable process, and Doob's maximal inequalities control the running maximum by the terminal value in probability and in L^p.

plot.title: 杜布分解示意：X = M + A（正弦和轨迹只作示意，非真实随机路径）

nodes.title: 鞅收敛定理
nodes.summary: L¹ 有界的下鞅几乎必然收敛到可积极限，但一般不 L¹ 收敛；一致可积才是把 a.s. 收敛升级为 L¹ 收敛的精确条件。
nodes.summaryEn: An L¹-bounded submartingale converges almost surely to an integrable limit, but not in L¹ in general; uniform integrability is exactly the extra condition upgrading almost sure convergence to L¹ convergence.

nodes.title: 伊藤积分
nodes.summary: 以简单可预测过程和伊藤等距为基础，把 ∫f dW 定义成 L² 极限；被积过程必须适应，否则等距与鞅性同时失效。
nodes.summaryEn: Using simple predictable processes and the Itô isometry, ∫f dW is defined as an L² limit; the integrand must be adapted, otherwise both the isometry and the martingale property break down.

plot.title: 伊藤积分示意：被积函数 f(t)=2t+1 与积分过程 I(t)（正弦和近似，非真实随机轨道）

nodes.title: 伊藤公式
nodes.summary: 随机分析的链式法则：由于布朗运动的二次变差是 t，泰勒展开的二阶项不能丢，df(W)=f′(W)dW+½f″(W)dt。
nodes.summaryEn: The chain rule of stochastic analysis: because Brownian motion has quadratic variation t, the second-order Taylor term survives, df(W)=f′(W)dW+½f″(W)dt.

plot.title: 伊藤公式示意：W_t、W_t² 与 W_t² − t（正弦和近似轨道，仅供示意）

nodes.title: 随机微分方程
nodes.summary: 由布朗运动驱动的微分方程 dX=μdt+σdW：Lipschitz 与线性增长条件保证唯一强解，线性情形给出几何布朗运动与 OU 过程。
nodes.summaryEn: Differential equations driven by Brownian motion, dX=μdt+σdW: Lipschitz and linear growth conditions give a unique strong solution; linear cases yield geometric Brownian motion and the OU process.

plot.title: 几何布朗运动的漂移场 y′=0.3y（示意：只画漂移项 μX dt，未含 σX dW 的随机涨落）

nodes.title: 吉尔萨诺夫定理
nodes.summary: 用指数鞅作密度换测度，就能给布朗运动加上（或去掉）漂移；本条目约定密度含 −∫θdW − ½∫θ²ds，结论是 W̃=W+∫θds 在 Q 下为布朗运动。
nodes.summaryEn: Changing measure with an exponential-martingale density adds or removes drift from Brownian motion; here the density carries −∫θdW − ½∫θ²ds and the conclusion is that W̃=W+∫θds is a Q-Brownian motion.

nodes.title: 黎曼度量
nodes.summary: 在每点切空间上光滑地指定一个内积：长度、夹角、体积由此内蕴地定义，并给出一个与原拓扑一致的黎曼距离。
nodes.summaryEn: A smooth assignment of an inner product on each tangent space: it makes length, angle and volume intrinsic and yields a Riemannian distance inducing the original topology.

plot.title: 曲面上的黎曼度量：切平面上逐点给定的内积

nodes.title: 列维-奇维塔联络
nodes.summary: 由度量唯一确定的求导法则：既度量相容（∇g=0，平行移动保内积）又无挠（下指标对称），两条缺一不可。
nodes.summaryEn: The unique differentiation law determined by the metric: compatible with it (∇g = 0, parallel transport preserves inner products) and torsion-free (symmetric lower indices); neither condition may be dropped.

nodes.title: 平行移动与和乐群
nodes.summary: 沿曲线协变导数为零的向量场给出切空间之间的线性等距同构；绕闭环平移一周所得变换构成的**和乐群**恰好测出曲率。
nodes.summaryEn: Vector fields with vanishing covariant derivative along a curve give linear isometries between tangent spaces; the transformations obtained around closed loops form the holonomy group, which measures curvature.

plot.title: 球面上平行移动一周：向量旋转所围立体角

nodes.title: 指数映射与单射半径
nodes.titleEn: The Exponential Map and Injectivity Radius
nodes.summary: exp_p 把切空间的直线映为流形上过 p 的测地线，在 0 附近是局部微分同胚；单射半径是它保持单射的最大半径，等于到割迹的距离。
nodes.summaryEn: exp_p maps straight lines in the tangent space to geodesics through p and is a local diffeomorphism near 0; the injectivity radius is the largest radius on which it stays injective and equals the distance to the cut locus.

plot.title: 测地极坐标中 r = √(x²+y²) 的等值线

nodes.title: 弧长第一变分
nodes.summary: 长度泛函沿变分族的一阶导数公式；固定端点时为 −∫⟨V, ∇_γ′γ′⟩dt，由此「测地线 = 临界点」「最短曲线必是测地线」，但反之不成立。
nodes.summaryEn: The first derivative of the length functional along a variation: with fixed endpoints it equals −∫⟨V, ∇_{γ'}γ'⟩dt, giving "geodesic = critical point" and "minimisers are geodesics", while the converse fails.

functions.label: 基曲线 γ（端点 x = 0 与 x = 3 固定）

plot.title: 固定端点的变分族：端点相同、长度不同

nodes.title: 黎曼曲率张量
nodes.summary: 度量与联络的二阶信息：R(X,Y)Z = ∇_X∇_YZ − ∇_Y∇_XZ − ∇_{[X,Y]}Z 度量「二阶协变导数不可交换」的程度，而 R ≡ 0 恰好刻画局部平坦。
nodes.summaryEn: The second-order invariant of the metric: R(X,Y)Z = ∇_X∇_YZ − ∇_Y∇_XZ − ∇_{[X,Y]}Z measures the failure of second covariant derivatives to commute, and R ≡ 0 characterises local flatness.

plot.title: 黎曼曲率张量度量二阶协变导数不可交换的程度：图中马鞍面处处 K<0，而球面这类曲面 K>0——只看一点的一阶信息看不出这种差别

nodes.title: 曲率张量的对称性与比安基恒等式
nodes.titleEn: Curvature Symmetries and the Bianchi Identities
nodes.summary: 曲率张量受五条代数对称性与两条比安基恒等式（一条代数、一条微分）约束，这些恒等式把它压缩到 n²(n²−1)/12 个独立分量（n=2,3,4 时为 1,6,20），并给出里奇张量对称与爱因斯坦张量守恒的源头。
nodes.summaryEn: The curvature tensor obeys five algebraic symmetries and two Bianchi identities (one algebraic, one differential); they cut it down to n²(n²−1)/12 independent components (1, 6, 20 for n = 2, 3, 4) and are the source of the symmetry of the Ricci tensor and of the conservation of the Einstein tensor.

nodes.title: 里奇曲率与数量曲率
nodes.summary: 把曲率张量缩并一次得到里奇张量（它自动对称）、再缩并得到数量曲率；第二比安基又使爱因斯坦张量 G_{ij}=R_{ij}−½Sg_{ij} 自动守恒（∇^iG_{ij}=0），这两个量是曲率里「平均」与「体积」的信息。
nodes.summaryEn: Contracting the curvature tensor once gives the Ricci tensor (automatically symmetric) and twice the scalar curvature; the second Bianchi identity makes the Einstein tensor G_{ij}=R_{ij}−½Sg_{ij} automatically divergence-free, ∇^iG_{ij}=0. These two carry the averaged, volume-theoretic part of the curvature.

plot.title: 曲率是随点变化的函数：马鞍面 z=xy 的 |K|=1/(1+x²+y²)² 的等值线；二维时 Ric=Kg、S=2K，这就是里奇/数量曲率场（鞍点处 |K| 最大）

nodes.title: 截面曲率
nodes.summary: 高斯曲率的高维推广：每个二维平面 σ 配上一个数 K(X,Y)=⟨R(X,Y)Y,X⟩/(|X|²|Y|²−⟨X,Y⟩²)（分母是 Gram 行列式）；K 与基的选取无关，并且（由对称性）反过来决定整个曲率张量。
